# Open one T case on an assessed direct vassal.  ROOT is the
# celestial duke-or-higher manager; counts and barons can only be this subject.

	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	if = {
		limit = {
			root = {
				zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
				has_variable = zg361_review_serial
			}
			zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
			liege = root
			has_variable = zg361_result_case_owner
			var:zg361_result_case_owner = root
			has_variable = zg361_result_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_result_cycle_serial = root.var:zg361_review_serial
			has_variable = zg361_result_case_serial
			has_variable = zg361_result_case_state
			var:zg361_result_case_state >= 3
			has_variable = zg361_result_grade
			has_variable = zg361_result_grade_reason
			has_variable = zg361_result_kpi_frozen
			has_variable = zg361_result_rank_frozen
			# Do not reuse this domain's receipt variables while any delayed
			# audit is pending.  The portfolio adapter may skip to another
			# domain and retry this one after the old receipt is terminal.
			NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m146_audit_1_state = 1 }
			NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m147_audit_1_state = 1 }
			NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m148_audit_1_state = 1 }
			NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m149_audit_1_state = 1 }

			limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }

zg361_pp_schedule_t_stage_01_effect = {
	zg361_case_kernel_schedule_deadline_effect = {
		OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
		SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
		CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
		CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
		STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
		ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
		DEADLINE_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_t_stage_1_deadline_owner
		DEADLINE_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_pp_t_stage_1_deadline_subject
		DEADLINE_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_t_stage_1_deadline_cycle
		DEADLINE_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_t_stage_1_deadline_case
		DEADLINE_STATE_VAR = zg361_pp_t_stage_1_deadline_state
		DEADLINE_DAYS_VAR = zg361_pp_t_stage_1_deadline_days
		DEADLINE_PENDING_VAR = zg361_pp_t_stage_1_deadline_pending
		DEADLINE_EXPIRED_VAR = zg361_pp_t_stage_1_deadline_expired
		TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_t_owner
		TICKET_SUBJECT = this
		TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
		TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_t_case_serial
		TICKET_STATE = 1
		DAYS = 30
		EVENT = zg361pp.4001
	}
}

zg361_pp_dispatch_t_stage_01_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_case_t_owner = { is_ai = yes zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
		# Owner-authorized second AI exception: background resolver only, no GUI.
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 1 }
if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_t_owner = { is_at_war = yes } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 3 } }
else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_t_owner = { OR = { has_trait = arbitrary has_trait = ambitious } } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 2 } }
zg361_pp_m146_core_effect = {
	ROUTE = var:zg361_pp_ai_route
	TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_t_owner
	TICKET_SUBJECT = this
	TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
	TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_t_case_serial
	TICKET_STATE = 1
}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 1 }
if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_t_owner = { is_at_war = yes } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 3 } }
else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_t_owner = { OR = { has_trait = arbitrary has_trait = ambitious } } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 2 } }
zg361_pp_m147_core_effect = {
	ROUTE = var:zg361_pp_ai_route
	TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_t_owner
	TICKET_SUBJECT = this
	TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
	TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_t_case_serial
	TICKET_STATE = 1
}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 1 }
if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_t_owner = { is_at_war = yes } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 3 } }
else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_t_owner = { OR = { has_trait = arbitrary has_trait = ambitious } } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 2 } }
zg361_pp_m148_core_effect = {
	ROUTE = var:zg361_pp_ai_route
	TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_t_owner
	TICKET_SUBJECT = this
	TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
	TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_t_case_serial
	TICKET_STATE = 1
}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_case_t_owner = { is_ai = no zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
		# Exactly one visible decision is queued.  Each option schedules only the
		# next card, so a 46-card popup storm is structurally impossible.
		save_scope_as = zg361_pp_prompt_subject
		var:zg361_case_t_owner = { save_scope_as = zg361_pp_prompt_owner }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_prompt_cycle value = var:zg361_case_t_cycle_serial }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_prompt_case value = var:zg361_case_t_case_serial }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_prompt_state value = 1 }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_prompt_mechanism value = 146 }
		var:zg361_case_t_owner = { trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.146 days = 1 } }
	}
}

else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_t_owner = { OR = { has_trait = arbitrary has_trait = ambitious } } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 2 } }
zg361_pp_m156_core_effect = {
	ROUTE = var:zg361_pp_ai_route
	TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_t_owner
	TICKET_SUBJECT = this
	TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
	TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_t_case_serial
	TICKET_STATE = 4
}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_case_t_owner = { is_ai = no zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
		# Exactly one visible decision is queued.  Each option schedules only the
		# next card, so a 46-card popup storm is structurally impossible.
		save_scope_as = zg361_pp_prompt_subject
		var:zg361_case_t_owner = { save_scope_as = zg361_pp_prompt_owner }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_prompt_cycle value = var:zg361_case_t_cycle_serial }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_prompt_case value = var:zg361_case_t_case_serial }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_prompt_state value = 4 }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_prompt_mechanism value = 155 }
		var:zg361_case_t_owner = { trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.155 days = 1 } }
	}
}

zg361_pp_t_try_advance_04_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_t_owner
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
				EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_t_case_serial
				EXPECTED_STATE = 4
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m155_consumed = 1
			var:zg361_pp_m156_consumed = 1
		}
		zg361_case_t_advance_04_effect = {
			TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_t_owner
			TICKET_SUBJECT = this
			TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
			TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_t_case_serial
		}
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 } zg361_pp_resolve_t_outcome_effect = yes }
	}
}

zg361_pp_t_timeout_stage_04_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m155_consumed = 0 }
		zg361_pp_m155_core_effect = {
			ROUTE = 3
			TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_pp_t_stage_4_deadline_owner
			TICKET_SUBJECT = var:zg361_pp_t_stage_4_deadline_subject
			TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_pp_t_stage_4_deadline_cycle
			TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_pp_t_stage_4_deadline_case
			TICKET_STATE = var:zg361_pp_t_stage_4_deadline_state
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m156_consumed = 0 }
		zg361_pp_m156_core_effect = {
			ROUTE = 3
			TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_pp_t_stage_4_deadline_owner
			TICKET_SUBJECT = var:zg361_pp_t_stage_4_deadline_subject
			TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_pp_t_stage_4_deadline_cycle
			TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_pp_t_stage_4_deadline_case
			TICKET_STATE = var:zg361_pp_t_stage_4_deadline_state
		}
	}
	debug_log = "ZG361PP: exact T stage 4 deadline consumed"
}

zg361_pp_resolve_t_outcome_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:zg361_pp_t_completed = var:zg361_pp_t_authorized
			var:zg361_pp_t_resource_conserved = 1
			var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_conserved = 1
			var:zg361_pp_t_commitment_capacity_conserved = 1
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_outcome value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_t_evidence_led > var:zg361_pp_t_political } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_outcome value = 1 } add_prestige = 25 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_t_political > var:zg361_pp_t_evidence_led } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_outcome value = -1 } add_stress = minor_stress_gain var:zg361_case_t_owner = { change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_management_debt add = 1 } } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_visible_receipt_revision value = var:zg361_case_t_revision }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_portfolio_done_cycle value = var:zg361_case_t_cycle_serial }
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_case_t_owner = { is_ai = no } }
			save_scope_as = zg361_pp_completion_subject
			# Retain the queue lock through the visible completion card, otherwise a
			# same-day central adapter call could overlap it with the next domain.
			var:zg361_case_t_owner = { trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.9001 days = 1 } }
		}
		else = {
			# The authorized AI route has no visible card and releases immediately.
			var:zg361_case_t_owner = { set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_portfolio_queue_active value = 0 } }
		}
		debug_log = "ZG361PP: completed T runtime case"
	}
}

# celestial duke-or-higher manager; counts and barons can only be this subject.

	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied

		limit = {
			root = {
				zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes

			}
			zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
			liege = root
			has_variable = zg361_result_case_owner

			var:zg361_result_cycle_serial = root.var:zg361_review_serial

			var:zg361_result_case_state >= 3
			has_variable = zg361_result_grade
			var:zg361_result_grade >= 2
			has_variable = zg361_result_grade_reason
			# Do not reuse this domain's receipt variables while any delayed
			# audit is pending.  The portfolio adapter may skip to another
			# domain and retry this one after the old receipt is terminal.
			NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m157_audit_1_state = 1 }
			NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m158_audit_1_state = 1 }
			NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m159_audit_1_state = 1 }

		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m168_receipt_active value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m168_visible_outcome_code value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_stage_1_deadline_pending value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_stage_1_deadline_expired value = 0 }
		remove_variable = zg361_pp_u_stage_1_deadline_owner
		remove_variable = zg361_pp_u_stage_1_deadline_subject
		remove_variable = zg361_pp_u_stage_1_deadline_cycle
		remove_variable = zg361_pp_u_stage_1_deadline_case
		remove_variable = zg361_pp_u_stage_1_deadline_state
		remove_variable = zg361_pp_u_stage_1_deadline_days
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_stage_2_deadline_pending value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_stage_2_deadline_expired value = 0 }
		remove_variable = zg361_pp_u_stage_2_deadline_owner
		remove_variable = zg361_pp_u_stage_2_deadline_subject
		remove_variable = zg361_pp_u_stage_2_deadline_cycle
		remove_variable = zg361_pp_u_stage_2_deadline_case
		remove_variable = zg361_pp_u_stage_2_deadline_state
		remove_variable = zg361_pp_u_stage_2_deadline_days
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_stage_3_deadline_pending value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_stage_3_deadline_expired value = 0 }

		remove_variable = zg361_pp_u_stage_4_deadline_owner
		remove_variable = zg361_pp_u_stage_4_deadline_subject
		remove_variable = zg361_pp_u_stage_4_deadline_cycle
		remove_variable = zg361_pp_u_stage_4_deadline_case
		remove_variable = zg361_pp_u_stage_4_deadline_state
		remove_variable = zg361_pp_u_stage_4_deadline_days
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_nomination_slot_authorized value = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_nomination_slot_available value = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_nomination_slot_reserved value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_nomination_slot_settled value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_nomination_slot_conserved value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_capacity_hours_authorized value = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_capacity_hours_available value = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_capacity_hours_reserved value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_capacity_hours_settled value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_capacity_hours_conserved value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_tenure_exception_slot_authorized value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_tenure_exception_slot_available value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_tenure_exception_slot_reserved value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_tenure_exception_slot_settled value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_tenure_exception_slot_conserved value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_promotion_slot_authorized value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_promotion_slot_available value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_promotion_slot_reserved value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_promotion_slot_settled value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_promotion_slot_conserved value = 1 }
			# Freeze the delivered result identity and candidate boundary before
			# nomination politics can move either one.
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_result_owner value = var:zg361_result_case_owner }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_result_subject value = this }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_result_cycle value = var:zg361_result_cycle_serial }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_result_case value = var:zg361_result_case_serial }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_result_state value = var:zg361_result_case_state }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_frozen_grade value = var:zg361_result_grade }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_frozen_reason value = var:zg361_result_grade_reason }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_candidate_eligible value = 0 }
			if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_u_frozen_grade >= 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_candidate_eligible value = 1 } }
			# Persistent shelving obligations are consumed once per later review cycle.
			root = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						trigger_if = {
							limit = {
								has_variable = zg361_pp_u_shelving_active
								has_variable = zg361_pp_u_shelving_due_cycle
								has_variable = zg361_pp_u_shelving_last_penalty_cycle
								has_variable = zg361_pp_u_shelving_nominated
							}
							var:zg361_pp_u_shelving_active = 1
							var:zg361_pp_u_shelving_nominated = 0
							var:zg361_review_serial >= var:zg361_pp_u_shelving_due_cycle
							NOT = { var:zg361_pp_u_shelving_last_penalty_cycle = var:zg361_review_serial }
						}
						trigger_else = { always = no }
					}
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_management_talent_score add = -1 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_management_debt add = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_shelving_last_penalty_cycle value = var:zg361_review_serial }
				}
			}
			# Matured #168 observations alter only the next cycle's quota, once and clamped.
			if = {
				limit = { root = { has_variable = zg361_pp_u_next_quota_pending var:zg361_pp_u_next_quota_pending = 1 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = zg361_pp_u_nomination_slot_authorized
					value = { value = var:zg361_pp_u_nomination_slot_authorized add = root.var:zg361_pp_u_next_quota_delta min = 1 max = 3 }
				}
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_nomination_slot_available value = var:zg361_pp_u_nomination_slot_authorized }
				root = {
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_next_quota_pending value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_next_quota_consumed_cycle value = var:zg361_review_serial }
				}
			}
			# Freeze a distinct filler candidate before #161 can spend real quota/hours.
			remove_variable = zg361_pp_m161_filler_candidate
			save_temporary_scope_as = zg361_pp_u_main_candidate
			root = {
				ordered_vassal = {
					limit = {
						zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
						NOT = { this = scope:zg361_pp_u_main_candidate }
					}
					order_by = stewardship
					position = 0
					save_temporary_scope_as = zg361_pp_u_filler_candidate
				}
			}
			if = { limit = { exists = scope:zg361_pp_u_filler_candidate } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m161_filler_candidate value = scope:zg361_pp_u_filler_candidate } }
			root = { set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_portfolio_queue_active value = 1 } }
			zg361_pp_schedule_u_stage_01_effect = yes
			zg361_pp_dispatch_u_stage_01_effect = yes
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
		}
	}
}

		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 1 }

else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_u_owner = { OR = { has_trait = arbitrary has_trait = ambitious } } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 2 } }

	TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_u_owner
	TICKET_SUBJECT = this
	TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
	TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_u_case_serial
	TICKET_STATE = 1
}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_case_u_owner = { is_ai = no zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
		# Exactly one visible decision is queued.  Each option schedules only the
		# next card, so a 46-card popup storm is structurally impossible.
		save_scope_as = zg361_pp_prompt_subject
		var:zg361_case_u_owner = { save_scope_as = zg361_pp_prompt_owner }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_prompt_cycle value = var:zg361_case_u_cycle_serial }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_prompt_case value = var:zg361_case_u_case_serial }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_prompt_state value = 1 }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_prompt_mechanism value = 157 }
		var:zg361_case_u_owner = { trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.157 days = 1 } }
	}
}

	TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
	TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_u_case_serial
	TICKET_STATE = 2
}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_case_u_owner = { is_ai = no zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
		# Exactly one visible decision is queued.  Each option schedules only the
		# next card, so a 46-card popup storm is structurally impossible.
		save_scope_as = zg361_pp_prompt_subject
		var:zg361_case_u_owner = { save_scope_as = zg361_pp_prompt_owner }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_prompt_cycle value = var:zg361_case_u_cycle_serial }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_prompt_case value = var:zg361_case_u_case_serial }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_prompt_state value = 2 }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_prompt_mechanism value = 163 }
		var:zg361_case_u_owner = { trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.163 days = 1 } }
	}
}

zg361_pp_resolve_u_outcome_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:zg361_pp_u_completed = var:zg361_pp_u_authorized
			var:zg361_pp_u_resource_conserved = 1
			var:zg361_pp_u_capacity_hours_conserved = 1
			var:zg361_pp_u_nomination_slot_conserved = 1
			var:zg361_pp_u_promotion_slot_conserved = 1
			var:zg361_pp_u_tenure_exception_slot_conserved = 1
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_outcome value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_u_evidence_led > var:zg361_pp_u_political } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_outcome value = 1 } add_prestige = 25 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_u_political > var:zg361_pp_u_evidence_led } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_outcome value = -1 } add_stress = minor_stress_gain var:zg361_case_u_owner = { change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_management_debt add = 1 } } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_visible_receipt_revision value = var:zg361_case_u_revision }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_portfolio_done_cycle value = var:zg361_case_u_cycle_serial }
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_case_u_owner = { is_ai = no } }
			save_scope_as = zg361_pp_completion_subject
			# Retain the queue lock through the visible completion card, otherwise a
			# same-day central adapter call could overlap it with the next domain.
			var:zg361_case_u_owner = { trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.9002 days = 1 } }
		}
		else = {
			# The authorized AI route has no visible card and releases immediately.
			var:zg361_case_u_owner = { set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_portfolio_queue_active value = 0 } }
		}
		debug_log = "ZG361PP: completed U runtime case"
	}
}

# Open one V case on an assessed direct vassal.  ROOT is the
# celestial duke-or-higher manager; counts and barons can only be this subject.
zg361_pp_open_v_case_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	if = {
		limit = {
			root = {
				zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
				has_variable = zg361_review_serial
			}
			zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
			liege = root
			var:zg361_pp_m160_prescreen_pass = 1
			var:zg361_pp_m160_packet_candidate_consumed = this
			var:zg361_pp_m160_promotion_slot_status = 1
			# Do not reuse this domain's receipt variables while any delayed
			# audit is pending.  The portfolio adapter may skip to another
			# domain and retry this one after the old receipt is terminal.
			NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m169_audit_1_state = 1 }
			NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m170_audit_1_state = 1 }

		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_stage_3_deadline_pending value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_stage_3_deadline_expired value = 0 }
		remove_variable = zg361_pp_v_stage_3_deadline_owner
		remove_variable = zg361_pp_v_stage_3_deadline_subject
		remove_variable = zg361_pp_v_stage_3_deadline_cycle
		remove_variable = zg361_pp_v_stage_3_deadline_case
		remove_variable = zg361_pp_v_stage_3_deadline_state
		remove_variable = zg361_pp_v_stage_3_deadline_days
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_stage_4_deadline_pending value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_stage_4_deadline_expired value = 0 }
		remove_variable = zg361_pp_v_stage_4_deadline_owner
		remove_variable = zg361_pp_v_stage_4_deadline_subject
		remove_variable = zg361_pp_v_stage_4_deadline_cycle
		remove_variable = zg361_pp_v_stage_4_deadline_case
		remove_variable = zg361_pp_v_stage_4_deadline_state
		remove_variable = zg361_pp_v_stage_4_deadline_days
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_stage_5_deadline_pending value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_stage_5_deadline_expired value = 0 }
		remove_variable = zg361_pp_v_stage_5_deadline_owner
		remove_variable = zg361_pp_v_stage_5_deadline_subject
		remove_variable = zg361_pp_v_stage_5_deadline_cycle
		remove_variable = zg361_pp_v_stage_5_deadline_case
		remove_variable = zg361_pp_v_stage_5_deadline_state
		remove_variable = zg361_pp_v_stage_5_deadline_days
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_authorized value = 9 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_available value = 9 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_reserved value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_settled value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_conserved value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_authorized value = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_available value = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_reserved value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_settled value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_conserved value = 1 }
			# Consume the one real U prescreen winner and freeze three active seats plus
			# one clean alternate.  The candidate cannot manufacture a panel without a
			# passed packet and the reserved promotion slot is settled exactly once here.
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_source_packet_case value = var:zg361_pp_m157_packet_case }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_source_prescreen_case value = var:zg361_pp_m160_receipt_case }
			if = {
				limit = { var:zg361_pp_m160_promotion_slot_status = 1 }
				change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_promotion_slot_reserved add = -1 }
				change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_promotion_slot_settled add = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m160_promotion_slot_status value = 2 }
			}
			remove_variable = zg361_pp_v_panel_pool_1
			remove_variable = zg361_pp_v_panel_pool_2
			remove_variable = zg361_pp_v_panel_pool_3
			remove_variable = zg361_pp_v_panel_pool_4
			save_temporary_scope_as = zg361_pp_v_candidate
			root = {
				ordered_vassal = {
					limit = {
						zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
						NOT = { this = scope:zg361_pp_v_candidate }
					}
					order_by = stewardship
					position = 0
					save_temporary_scope_as = zg361_pp_v_pool_1
				}
				ordered_vassal = {
					limit = {
						zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
						NOT = { this = scope:zg361_pp_v_candidate }
					}
					order_by = stewardship
					position = 1
					save_temporary_scope_as = zg361_pp_v_pool_2
				}
				ordered_vassal = {
					limit = {
						zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
						NOT = { this = scope:zg361_pp_v_candidate }
					}
					order_by = stewardship
					position = 2
					save_temporary_scope_as = zg361_pp_v_pool_3
				}
				ordered_vassal = {
					limit = {
						zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
						NOT = { this = scope:zg361_pp_v_candidate }
					}
					order_by = stewardship
					position = 3
					save_temporary_scope_as = zg361_pp_v_pool_4
				}
			}
			if = { limit = { exists = scope:zg361_pp_v_pool_1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_panel_pool_1 value = scope:zg361_pp_v_pool_1 } }
			if = { limit = { exists = scope:zg361_pp_v_pool_2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_panel_pool_2 value = scope:zg361_pp_v_pool_2 } }
			if = { limit = { exists = scope:zg361_pp_v_pool_3 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_panel_pool_3 value = scope:zg361_pp_v_pool_3 } }
			if = { limit = { exists = scope:zg361_pp_v_pool_4 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_panel_pool_4 value = scope:zg361_pp_v_pool_4 } }
			root = { set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_portfolio_queue_active value = 1 } }
			zg361_pp_schedule_v_stage_01_effect = yes
			zg361_pp_dispatch_v_stage_01_effect = yes
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
		}
	}
}

zg361_pp_schedule_v_stage_01_effect = {
	zg361_case_kernel_schedule_deadline_effect = {
		OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
		SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
		CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
		CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial
		STATE_VAR = zg361_case_v_state
		ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_v_active
		DEADLINE_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_v_stage_1_deadline_owner
		DEADLINE_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_pp_v_stage_1_deadline_subject
		DEADLINE_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_v_stage_1_deadline_cycle
		DEADLINE_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_v_stage_1_deadline_case
		DEADLINE_STATE_VAR = zg361_pp_v_stage_1_deadline_state

		DEADLINE_EXPIRED_VAR = zg361_pp_v_stage_1_deadline_expired
		TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_v_owner
		TICKET_SUBJECT = this
		TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
		TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_v_case_serial
		TICKET_STATE = 1
		DAYS = 30
		EVENT = zg361pp.4021
	}
}

zg361_pp_dispatch_v_stage_01_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_case_v_owner = { is_ai = yes zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
		# Owner-authorized second AI exception: background resolver only, no GUI.
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 1 }
if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_v_owner = { is_at_war = yes } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 3 } }
else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_v_owner = { OR = { has_trait = arbitrary has_trait = ambitious } } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 2 } }
zg361_pp_m169_core_effect = {
	ROUTE = var:zg361_pp_ai_route
	TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_v_owner
	TICKET_SUBJECT = this
	TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
	TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_v_case_serial
	TICKET_STATE = 1
}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 1 }
if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_v_owner = { is_at_war = yes } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 3 } }
else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_v_owner = { OR = { has_trait = arbitrary has_trait = ambitious } } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 2 } }
zg361_pp_m170_core_effect = {
	ROUTE = var:zg361_pp_ai_route
	TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_v_owner
	TICKET_SUBJECT = this
	TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
	TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_v_case_serial
	TICKET_STATE = 1
}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 1 }
if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_v_owner = { is_at_war = yes } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 3 } }
else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_v_owner = { OR = { has_trait = arbitrary has_trait = ambitious } } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 2 } }
zg361_pp_m171_core_effect = {
	ROUTE = var:zg361_pp_ai_route
	TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_v_owner
	TICKET_SUBJECT = this
	TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
	TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_v_case_serial
	TICKET_STATE = 1
}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_case_v_owner = { is_ai = no zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
		# Exactly one visible decision is queued.  Each option schedules only the
		# next card, so a 46-card popup storm is structurally impossible.
		save_scope_as = zg361_pp_prompt_subject
		var:zg361_case_v_owner = { save_scope_as = zg361_pp_prompt_owner }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_prompt_cycle value = var:zg361_case_v_cycle_serial }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_prompt_case value = var:zg361_case_v_case_serial }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_prompt_state value = 1 }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_prompt_mechanism value = 169 }
		var:zg361_case_v_owner = { trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.169 days = 1 } }
	}
}

zg361_pp_resolve_v_outcome_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:zg361_pp_v_completed = var:zg361_pp_v_authorized
			var:zg361_pp_v_resource_conserved = 1
			var:zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_conserved = 1
			var:zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_conserved = 1
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_outcome value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_v_evidence_led > var:zg361_pp_v_political } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_outcome value = 1 } add_prestige = 25 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_v_political > var:zg361_pp_v_evidence_led } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_outcome value = -1 } add_stress = minor_stress_gain var:zg361_case_v_owner = { change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_management_debt add = 1 } } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_visible_receipt_revision value = var:zg361_case_v_revision }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_portfolio_done_cycle value = var:zg361_case_v_cycle_serial }
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_case_v_owner = { is_ai = no } }
			save_scope_as = zg361_pp_completion_subject
			# Retain the queue lock through the visible completion card, otherwise a
			# same-day central adapter call could overlap it with the next domain.
			var:zg361_case_v_owner = { trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.9003 days = 1 } }
		}
		else = {
			# The authorized AI route has no visible card and releases immediately.
			var:zg361_case_v_owner = { set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_portfolio_queue_active value = 0 } }
		}
		debug_log = "ZG361PP: completed V runtime case"
	}
}

# Open one W case on an assessed direct vassal.  ROOT is the
# celestial duke-or-higher manager; counts and barons can only be this subject.
zg361_pp_open_w_case_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	if = {
		limit = {
			root = {
				zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
				has_variable = zg361_review_serial
			}
			zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
			liege = root
			has_variable = zg361_result_case_owner
			var:zg361_result_case_owner = root
			has_variable = zg361_result_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_result_cycle_serial = root.var:zg361_review_serial
			has_variable = zg361_result_case_serial
			has_variable = zg361_result_case_state
			var:zg361_result_case_state >= 3
			has_variable = zg361_result_grade
			var:zg361_result_grade = 1
			has_variable = zg361_result_grade_reason
			has_variable = zg361_result_kpi_frozen
			has_variable = zg361_result_rank_frozen
			# Do not reuse this domain's receipt variables while any delayed
			# audit is pending.  The portfolio adapter may skip to another
			# domain and retry this one after the old receipt is terminal.
			NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m181_audit_1_state = 1 }
			NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m182_audit_1_state = 1 }
			NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m183_audit_1_state = 1 }
			NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m184_audit_1_state = 1 }
			NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m185_audit_1_state = 1 }
			NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m186_audit_1_state = 1 }
			NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m187_audit_1_state = 1 }
			NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m188_audit_1_state = 1 }
			NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m189_audit_1_state = 1 }
			NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m190_audit_1_state = 1 }
			NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m191_audit_1_state = 1 }
		}
		zg361_case_w_open_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_authorized value = 11 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_completed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_evidence_led value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_political value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_policy_debt value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_available value = 11 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_reserved value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_settled value = 0 }

			# A PIP begins from the delivered result's exact five-tuple and a
			# distinct real receiving-manager candidate.  Grade 3.25 is one signal, never
			# the whole evidence gate, and this runtime never rewrites result_grade.
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_result_owner value = var:zg361_result_case_owner }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_result_subject value = this }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_result_cycle value = var:zg361_result_cycle_serial }

			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_frozen_kpi value = var:zg361_result_kpi_frozen }

			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_non_aggravation_grade value = var:zg361_pp_w_frozen_grade }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_evidence_component_count value = 0 }
			if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_w_frozen_grade = 1 } change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_evidence_component_count add = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_w_frozen_reason > 0 } change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_evidence_component_count add = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = zg361_result_evidence_governance } change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_evidence_component_count add = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = zg361_result_evidence_capability } change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_evidence_component_count add = 1 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_pip_gate_candidate value = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:zg361_pp_w_frozen_grade = 1 var:zg361_pp_w_evidence_component_count >= 3 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_pip_gate_candidate value = 1 }
			}
			# A receiving manager does not prove that a vacancy exists.  The central
			# career/HC adapter must bind an exact active vacancy ID and its receiver on
			# this subject; this package only freezes and verifies that input.
			remove_variable = zg361_pp_w_receiving_manager
			remove_variable = zg361_pp_w_transfer_vacancy_id
			remove_variable = zg361_pp_w_transfer_vacancy_receiver
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_real_vacancy value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_transfer_vacancy_active value = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = zg361_transfer_vacancy_id
					has_variable = zg361_transfer_vacancy_receiver
					var:zg361_transfer_vacancy_active = 1
					NOT = { var:zg361_transfer_vacancy_receiver = this }
					var:zg361_transfer_vacancy_receiver = {
						zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
						NOT = { this = root }
					}
				}
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_receiving_manager value = var:zg361_transfer_vacancy_receiver }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_transfer_vacancy_receiver value = var:zg361_transfer_vacancy_receiver }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_transfer_vacancy_id value = var:zg361_transfer_vacancy_id }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_transfer_vacancy_active value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_real_vacancy value = 1 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_capacity_released value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_capacity_release_reason value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_visible_case_revision value = 0 }
			root = { set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_portfolio_queue_active value = 1 } }
			zg361_pp_schedule_w_stage_01_effect = yes
			zg361_pp_dispatch_w_stage_01_effect = yes
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
		}
	}
}

zg361_pp_dispatch_w_stage_01_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_case_w_owner = { is_ai = yes zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
		# Owner-authorized second AI exception: background resolver only, no GUI.
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 1 }
if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_w_owner = { is_at_war = yes } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 3 } }
else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_w_owner = { OR = { has_trait = arbitrary has_trait = ambitious } } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 2 } }
zg361_pp_m181_core_effect = {
	ROUTE = var:zg361_pp_ai_route
	TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_w_owner
	TICKET_SUBJECT = this
	TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
	TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_w_case_serial
	TICKET_STATE = 1
}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 1 }
if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_w_owner = { is_at_war = yes } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 3 } }
else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_w_owner = { OR = { has_trait = arbitrary has_trait = ambitious } } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 2 } }
zg361_pp_m182_core_effect = {

	TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_w_owner
	TICKET_SUBJECT = this
	TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
	TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_w_case_serial
	TICKET_STATE = 1
}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 1 }
if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_w_owner = { is_at_war = yes } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 3 } }
else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_w_owner = { OR = { has_trait = arbitrary has_trait = ambitious } } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 2 } }
zg361_pp_m183_core_effect = {
	ROUTE = var:zg361_pp_ai_route
	TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_w_owner
	TICKET_SUBJECT = this
	TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
	TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_w_case_serial
	TICKET_STATE = 1
}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_case_w_owner = { is_ai = no zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
		# Exactly one visible decision is queued.  Each option schedules only the
		# next card, so a 46-card popup storm is structurally impossible.
		save_scope_as = zg361_pp_prompt_subject
		var:zg361_case_w_owner = { save_scope_as = zg361_pp_prompt_owner }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_prompt_cycle value = var:zg361_case_w_cycle_serial }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_prompt_case value = var:zg361_case_w_case_serial }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_prompt_state value = 1 }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_prompt_mechanism value = 181 }
		var:zg361_case_w_owner = { trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.181 days = 1 } }
	}
}

zg361_pp_resolve_w_outcome_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:zg361_pp_w_completed = var:zg361_pp_w_authorized
			var:zg361_pp_w_resource_conserved = 1
			var:zg361_pp_w_exit_cost_conserved = 1
			var:zg361_pp_w_pip_capacity_conserved = 1
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_outcome value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_w_evidence_led > var:zg361_pp_w_political } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_outcome value = 1 } add_prestige = 25 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_w_political > var:zg361_pp_w_evidence_led } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_outcome value = -1 } add_stress = minor_stress_gain var:zg361_case_w_owner = { change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_management_debt add = 1 } } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_visible_receipt_revision value = var:zg361_case_w_revision }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_portfolio_done_cycle value = var:zg361_case_w_cycle_serial }
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_case_w_owner = { is_ai = no } }
			save_scope_as = zg361_pp_completion_subject
			# Retain the queue lock through the visible completion card, otherwise a
			# same-day central adapter call could overlap it with the next domain.
			var:zg361_case_w_owner = { trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.9004 days = 1 } }
		}
		else = {
			# The authorized AI route has no visible card and releases immediately.
			var:zg361_case_w_owner = { set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_portfolio_queue_active value = 0 } }
		}
		debug_log = "ZG361PP: completed W runtime case"
	}
}

			zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
			liege = root

				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject

				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial

				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
		}
		zg361_pp_m146_core_effect = {
			ROUTE = $ROUTE$
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
		}
	}
}

# 146 直白档位 / 委婉话术制度: typed A/B/C write -> 反馈会和申诉时钟读取同一冻结档位.
zg361_pp_m146_core_effect = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_cost_owner value = var:zg361_case_t_owner }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 }
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m146_receipt_active = 0
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				always = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				always = yes
			}
			else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				var:zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_available >= 1
				var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_available >= 1
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			always = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
			zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
			OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
			CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
			CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
			STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
			ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
			REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_t_revision
			TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_t_timeline_serial
			FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_t_feedback_revision
			LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_t_last_operation
			LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_t_last_choice
			RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m146_receipt_owner
			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_pp_m146_receipt_subject
			RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m146_receipt_cycle
			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m146_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_pp_m146_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_pp_m146_receipt_route
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			CHOICE = scope:zg361_pp_route
			OPERATION_ID = 146
			}
		}
		else = {
			# Route C is a policy-debt receipt, not a disguised business mutation.  It
			# deliberately does not call record_operation and therefore cannot change
			# the case revision, last operation, resource ledger, or typed payload.
			set_variable = { name = zg361_case_kernel_applied value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m146_receipt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m146_receipt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m146_receipt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m146_receipt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m146_receipt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m146_receipt_route value = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
					STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
					ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
					REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_t_revision
					AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_available
					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_reserved
					RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m146_operation_capacity_amount
					RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m146_operation_capacity_status
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m146_operation_capacity_owner
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m146_operation_capacity_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m146_operation_capacity_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
						CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
						REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_t_revision
						RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_reserved
						SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_settled
						RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m146_operation_capacity_amount
						RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m146_operation_capacity_status
						TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					}
				}
				zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
					STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
					ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
					REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_t_revision
					AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_available
					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_reserved
					RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m146_capacity_hours_amount
					RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m146_capacity_hours_status
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m146_capacity_hours_owner
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m146_capacity_hours_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m146_capacity_hours_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
						CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active

						SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_settled

						TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }

				}
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }

				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
						var:zg361_pp_m146_operation_capacity_status = 1
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_pp_m146_operation_capacity_status = 2
					}
					else = { always = yes }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
						var:zg361_pp_m146_capacity_hours_status = 1
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_pp_m146_capacity_hours_status = 2
					}
					else = { always = yes }
					always = yes
					always = yes
				}
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m146_receipt_active value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m146_route value = scope:zg361_pp_route }
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m146_delivery_style value = 1 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_evidence_led add = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m146_delivery_style value = 2 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_political add = 1 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m146_deferred value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m146_policy_debt_due_days value = 90 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_policy_debt add = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m146_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_t_owner }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m146_object_subject value = this }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m146_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_t_cycle_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m146_object_case value = var:zg361_case_t_case_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m146_object_state value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m146_frozen_grade value = var:zg361_pp_t_frozen_grade }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m146_disclosed_grade value = var:zg361_pp_t_frozen_grade }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m146_understood_grade value = var:zg361_pp_t_frozen_grade }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m146_understanding_gap value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m146_frozen_evidence_hash value = var:zg361_pp_t_frozen_evidence_hash }
					if = { limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m146_understood_grade value = 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m146_understanding_gap value = 1 } }

				}

				zg361_pp_m146_consume_effect = yes
				zg361_pp_m146_schedule_audit_1_effect = yes
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

zg361_pp_m146_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_pp_m146_receipt_owner
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = var:zg361_pp_m146_receipt_subject
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_pp_m146_receipt_cycle
				EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_pp_m146_receipt_case
				EXPECTED_STATE = var:zg361_pp_m146_receipt_state
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m146_receipt_active = 1
			var:zg361_pp_m146_consumed = 0
			has_variable = zg361_pp_m146_route
			always = yes
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m146_route = 3 } }
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m146_delivery_style
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m146_consumed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m146_consumer_revision value = var:zg361_case_t_revision }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m146_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m146_consumer_value value = var:zg361_pp_m146_delivery_style } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_completed add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_resource_partition value = var:zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_resource_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_t_resource_partition = var:zg361_pp_t_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_resource_conserved value = 1 } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_partition value = var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_partition add = var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_partition add = var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_partition = var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_conserved value = 1 } }
		zg361_pp_t_try_advance_01_effect = yes
	}
}

zg361_pp_m146_schedule_audit_1_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m146_audit_1_state = 0 var:zg361_pp_m146_receipt_active = 1 }

		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m146_audit_1_cycle value = var:zg361_case_t_cycle_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m146_audit_1_case value = var:zg361_case_t_case_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m146_audit_1_expected_state value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m146_audit_1_state value = 1 }
		if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m146_route = 3 }
		trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.2146 days = 90 }
	}
	else = { trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.2146 days = 30 } }
	}
}

zg361_pp_m147_manager_apply_effect = {

	if = {

			zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
			liege = root
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial

				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
		}
		zg361_pp_m147_core_effect = {
			ROUTE = $ROUTE$
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$

			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
		}
	}
}

# 147 强制“一扬一抑”反馈模板: typed A/B/C write -> 反馈质量表消费证据链接与套话数.

	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 }

				var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_available >= 1

			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }

				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }

		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }

			OPERATION_ID = 147
			}
		}
		else = {
			# Route C is a policy-debt receipt, not a disguised business mutation.  It
			# deliberately does not call record_operation and therefore cannot change

			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m147_receipt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m147_receipt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m147_receipt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m147_receipt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m147_receipt_route value = 3 }
		}

					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial

					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m147_operation_capacity_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$

					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m147_polarity_template value = 2 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_political add = 1 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m147_deferred value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m147_policy_debt_due_days value = 180 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_policy_debt add = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m147_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_t_owner }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m147_object_subject value = this }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m147_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_t_cycle_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m147_object_case value = var:zg361_case_t_case_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m147_object_state value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m147_evidence_hash_consumed value = var:zg361_pp_t_frozen_evidence_hash }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m147_supported_praise_n value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m147_supported_critique_n value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m147_unsupported_sentence_n value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m147_quality_credit value = 2 }
					if = { limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m147_supported_praise_n value = 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m147_supported_critique_n value = 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m147_unsupported_sentence_n value = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m147_quality_credit value = 0 } }

				}

				zg361_pp_m147_consume_effect = yes
				zg361_pp_m147_schedule_audit_1_effect = yes
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

zg361_pp_m147_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_pp_m147_receipt_owner
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = var:zg361_pp_m147_receipt_subject
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_pp_m147_receipt_cycle
				EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_pp_m147_receipt_case
				EXPECTED_STATE = var:zg361_pp_m147_receipt_state
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m147_receipt_active = 1
			var:zg361_pp_m147_consumed = 0
			has_variable = zg361_pp_m147_route
			always = yes
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m147_route = 3 } }
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m147_polarity_template
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m147_consumed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m147_consumer_revision value = var:zg361_case_t_revision }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m147_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m147_consumer_value value = var:zg361_pp_m147_polarity_template } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_completed add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_resource_partition value = var:zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_resource_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_t_resource_partition = var:zg361_pp_t_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_resource_conserved value = 1 } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_partition value = var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_partition add = var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_partition add = var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_partition = var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_conserved value = 1 } }
		zg361_pp_t_try_advance_01_effect = yes
	}
}

zg361_pp_m147_schedule_audit_1_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m147_audit_1_state = 0 var:zg361_pp_m147_receipt_active = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m147_audit_1_owner value = var:zg361_case_t_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m147_audit_1_subject value = this }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m147_audit_1_cycle value = var:zg361_case_t_cycle_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m147_audit_1_case value = var:zg361_case_t_case_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m147_audit_1_expected_state value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m147_audit_1_state value = 1 }
		if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m147_route = 3 }
		trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.2147 days = 180 }
	}
	else = { trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.2147 days = 30 } }
	}
}

zg361_pp_m148_manager_apply_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	if = {
		limit = {
			root = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
			zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
			liege = root
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
		}
		zg361_pp_m148_core_effect = {
			ROUTE = $ROUTE$
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
		}
	}
}

# 148 先讲证据还是先报结果: typed A/B/C write -> 纪要保存步骤顺序、确认和异议.
zg361_pp_m148_core_effect = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_cost_owner value = var:zg361_case_t_owner }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 }
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m148_receipt_active = 0
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				always = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				always = yes
			}
			else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				var:zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_available >= 1
				var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_available >= 1
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			always = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
			zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
			OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
			CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
			CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
			STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
			ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
			REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_t_revision

			FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_t_feedback_revision

			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_pp_m148_receipt_subject
			RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m148_receipt_cycle
			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m148_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_pp_m148_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_pp_m148_receipt_route
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			CHOICE = scope:zg361_pp_route
			OPERATION_ID = 148
			}
		}
		else = {
			# Route C is a policy-debt receipt, not a disguised business mutation.  It
			# deliberately does not call record_operation and therefore cannot change
			# the case revision, last operation, resource ledger, or typed payload.
			set_variable = { name = zg361_case_kernel_applied value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m148_receipt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m148_receipt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m148_receipt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m148_receipt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m148_receipt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m148_receipt_route value = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
					STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
					ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
					REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_t_revision
					AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_available
					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_reserved
					RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m148_operation_capacity_amount
					RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m148_operation_capacity_status
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m148_operation_capacity_owner
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m148_operation_capacity_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m148_operation_capacity_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
						CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
						REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_t_revision
						RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_reserved
						SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_settled
						RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m148_operation_capacity_amount
						RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m148_operation_capacity_status
						TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					}
				}
				zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
					STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
					ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
					REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_t_revision
					AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_available
					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_reserved
					RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m148_capacity_hours_amount
					RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m148_capacity_hours_status
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m148_capacity_hours_owner
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m148_capacity_hours_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m148_capacity_hours_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
						CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
						REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_t_revision
						RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_reserved
						SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_settled
						RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m148_capacity_hours_amount
						RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m148_capacity_hours_status
						TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					}
				}

					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }

				}
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }

				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					trigger_if = {

						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_pp_m148_operation_capacity_status = 2

						var:zg361_pp_m148_capacity_hours_status = 1
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_pp_m148_capacity_hours_status = 2
					}
					else = { always = yes }
					always = yes
					always = yes
				}
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m148_receipt_active value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m148_route value = scope:zg361_pp_route }

					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m148_rating_snapshot value = var:zg361_pp_t_frozen_grade }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m148_step_order value = 1 }

					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m148_dispute_open value = 0 }

zg361_pp_m148_schedule_audit_1_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m148_audit_1_state = 0 var:zg361_pp_m148_receipt_active = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m148_audit_1_owner value = var:zg361_case_t_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m148_audit_1_subject value = this }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m148_audit_1_cycle value = var:zg361_case_t_cycle_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m148_audit_1_case value = var:zg361_case_t_case_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m148_audit_1_expected_state value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m148_audit_1_state value = 1 }
		if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m148_route = 3 }
		trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.2148 days = 90 }
	}
	else = { trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.2148 days = 30 } }
	}
}

zg361_pp_m149_manager_apply_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	if = {
		limit = {
			root = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
			zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
			liege = root
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
		}
		zg361_pp_m149_core_effect = {
			ROUTE = $ROUTE$
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
		}
	}
}

			var:zg361_pp_m149_receipt_active = 0

				always = yes

			else = { always = yes }

		else = {

			set_variable = { name = zg361_case_kernel_applied value = 1 }

					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial

					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }

					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
					STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
					ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
					REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_t_revision
					AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_t_commitment_capacity_available
					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_t_commitment_capacity_reserved

zg361_pp_m149_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_pp_m149_receipt_owner
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = var:zg361_pp_m149_receipt_subject
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_pp_m149_receipt_cycle
				EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_pp_m149_receipt_case
				EXPECTED_STATE = var:zg361_pp_m149_receipt_state
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m149_receipt_active = 1
			var:zg361_pp_m149_consumed = 0
			has_variable = zg361_pp_m149_route
			always = yes
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m149_route = 3 } }
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m149_bargain_terms
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m149_consumed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m149_consumer_revision value = var:zg361_case_t_revision }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m149_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m149_consumer_value value = var:zg361_pp_m149_bargain_terms } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_completed add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_resource_partition value = var:zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_resource_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_t_resource_partition = var:zg361_pp_t_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_resource_conserved value = 1 } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_partition value = var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_partition add = var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_partition add = var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_partition = var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_conserved value = 1 } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_commitment_capacity_partition value = var:zg361_pp_t_commitment_capacity_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_commitment_capacity_partition add = var:zg361_pp_t_commitment_capacity_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_commitment_capacity_partition add = var:zg361_pp_t_commitment_capacity_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_commitment_capacity_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_t_commitment_capacity_partition = var:zg361_pp_t_commitment_capacity_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_commitment_capacity_conserved value = 1 } }
		zg361_pp_t_try_advance_02_effect = yes
	}
}

		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m149_audit_1_state value = 1 }
		if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m149_route = 3 }
		trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.2149 days = 180 }
	}
	else = { trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.2149 days = 180 } }
	}
}

# 150 “这次先委屈你”的补偿承诺: typed A/B/C write -> 承诺时间线到期后结算履约或背约.
zg361_pp_m150_core_effect = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_cost_owner value = var:zg361_case_t_owner }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 }
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {

				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m150_receipt_active = 0
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				always = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				always = yes
			}
			else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				var:zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_available >= 1
				var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_available >= 1
var:zg361_pp_t_commitment_capacity_available >= 1
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				var:zg361_pp_cost_owner = {
					government_has_flag = government_has_treasury
					treasury >= 5
					gold >= 5
				}
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
			zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
			OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject

			CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial

			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			CHOICE = scope:zg361_pp_route
			OPERATION_ID = 150
			}
		}
		else = {
			# Route C is a policy-debt receipt, not a disguised business mutation.  It
			# deliberately does not call record_operation and therefore cannot change
			# the case revision, last operation, resource ledger, or typed payload.
			set_variable = { name = zg361_case_kernel_applied value = 1 }

			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m150_receipt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }

			limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }

					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject

					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m150_operation_capacity_owner

					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }

					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
					STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state

					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_reserved

					RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m150_capacity_hours_status
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m150_capacity_hours_owner
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m150_capacity_hours_cycle

					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$

					AMOUNT = 1
				}

					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject

						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
