					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
					STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
					ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
					REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_t_revision
					AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_t_commitment_capacity_available
					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_t_commitment_capacity_reserved

					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$

					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {

						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject

						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial

						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_pp_m150_operation_capacity_status = 2

					trigger_if = {

					}
				}

				zg361_pp_m150_consume_effect = yes
				zg361_pp_m150_schedule_audit_1_effect = yes

			}

zg361_pp_m150_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_pp_m150_receipt_owner
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = var:zg361_pp_m150_receipt_subject
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_pp_m150_receipt_cycle
				EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_pp_m150_receipt_case
				EXPECTED_STATE = var:zg361_pp_m150_receipt_state
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m150_receipt_active = 1
			var:zg361_pp_m150_consumed = 0
			has_variable = zg361_pp_m150_route
			always = yes
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m150_route = 3 } }
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m150_sacrifice_promise
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m150_consumed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m150_consumer_revision value = var:zg361_case_t_revision }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m150_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m150_consumer_value value = var:zg361_pp_m150_sacrifice_promise } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_completed add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_resource_partition value = var:zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_resource_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_t_resource_partition = var:zg361_pp_t_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_resource_conserved value = 1 } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_partition value = var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_partition add = var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_partition add = var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_partition = var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_conserved value = 1 } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_commitment_capacity_partition value = var:zg361_pp_t_commitment_capacity_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_commitment_capacity_partition add = var:zg361_pp_t_commitment_capacity_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_commitment_capacity_partition add = var:zg361_pp_t_commitment_capacity_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_commitment_capacity_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_t_commitment_capacity_partition = var:zg361_pp_t_commitment_capacity_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_commitment_capacity_conserved value = 1 } }
		zg361_pp_t_try_advance_02_effect = yes
	}
}

zg361_pp_m151_manager_apply_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	if = {
		limit = {
			root = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
			zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
			liege = root
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
		}
		zg361_pp_m151_core_effect = {
			ROUTE = $ROUTE$
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
		}
	}
}

# The assessed official may respond only to their own packet.  This grants no
# cohort, nomination, panel, PIP-initiation or assessment authority.
zg361_pp_m151_subject_response_effect = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_subject_route value = $ROUTE$ }
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_ai = no
			OR = { scope:zg361_pp_subject_route = 1 scope:zg361_pp_subject_route = 2 }
			zg361_case_kernel_subject_self_guard_trigger = {
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
			}
			var:zg361_case_t_state = 2
			NOT = { has_variable = zg361_pp_m151_subject_response }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m151_subject_response value = scope:zg361_pp_subject_route }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:zg361_pp_subject_route = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m151_agreed value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m151_disputed value = 0 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:zg361_pp_subject_route = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m151_appeal_filed value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m151_appeal_snapshot_grade value = var:zg361_pp_m151_non_aggravation_grade }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m151_disputed value = 1 }
		}
		change_variable = { name = zg361_case_t_feedback_revision add = 1 }
	}
}

# 151 签收不等于认同: typed A/B/C write -> 收据行、见证送达与申诉案卷分别消费.
zg361_pp_m151_core_effect = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_cost_owner value = var:zg361_case_t_owner }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 }
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m151_receipt_active = 0
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				always = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				always = yes
			}
			else = { always = yes }

				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				var:zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_available >= 1
				var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_available >= 1
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			always = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
			zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
			OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject

			CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial

			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_pp_m151_receipt_subject
			RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m151_receipt_cycle
			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m151_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_pp_m151_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_pp_m151_receipt_route
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			CHOICE = scope:zg361_pp_route
			OPERATION_ID = 151
			}
		}
		else = {
			# Route C is a policy-debt receipt, not a disguised business mutation.  It
			# deliberately does not call record_operation and therefore cannot change
			# the case revision, last operation, resource ledger, or typed payload.
			set_variable = { name = zg361_case_kernel_applied value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m151_receipt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m151_receipt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m151_receipt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m151_receipt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m151_receipt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m151_receipt_route value = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
					STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
					ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
					REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_t_revision
					AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_available
					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_reserved
					RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m151_operation_capacity_amount
					RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m151_operation_capacity_status
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m151_operation_capacity_owner
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m151_operation_capacity_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m151_operation_capacity_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
						CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
						REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_t_revision
						RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_reserved
						SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_settled
						RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m151_operation_capacity_amount
						RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m151_operation_capacity_status
						TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					}
				}
				zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
					STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
					ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
					REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_t_revision
					AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_available
					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_reserved
					RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m151_capacity_hours_amount
					RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m151_capacity_hours_status
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m151_capacity_hours_owner
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m151_capacity_hours_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m151_capacity_hours_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
						CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
						REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_t_revision
						RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_reserved
						SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_settled
						RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m151_capacity_hours_amount
						RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m151_capacity_hours_status
						TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }

				}
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }

				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
						var:zg361_pp_m151_operation_capacity_status = 1
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_pp_m151_operation_capacity_status = 2
					}
					else = { always = yes }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
						var:zg361_pp_m151_capacity_hours_status = 1
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_pp_m151_capacity_hours_status = 2
					}
					else = { always = yes }
					always = yes
					always = yes
				}
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m151_receipt_active value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m151_route value = scope:zg361_pp_route }

					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_evidence_led add = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m151_receipt_agreement value = 2 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_political add = 1 }
				}
				else = {

					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m151_policy_debt_due_days value = 90 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_policy_debt add = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }

					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m151_agreed value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m151_disputed value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m151_witness_required value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m151_appeal_eligible value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m151_appeal_due_days value = 90 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m151_grade_at_delivery value = var:zg361_pp_t_frozen_grade }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m151_non_aggravation_grade value = var:zg361_pp_t_frozen_grade }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m151_appeal_filed value = 0 }

zg361_pp_m151_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_pp_m151_receipt_owner
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = var:zg361_pp_m151_receipt_subject
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_pp_m151_receipt_cycle
				EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_pp_m151_receipt_case
				EXPECTED_STATE = var:zg361_pp_m151_receipt_state
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m151_receipt_active = 1
			var:zg361_pp_m151_consumed = 0
			has_variable = zg361_pp_m151_route
			always = yes
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m151_route = 3 } }
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m151_receipt_agreement
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m151_consumed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m151_consumer_revision value = var:zg361_case_t_revision }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m151_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m151_consumer_value value = var:zg361_pp_m151_receipt_agreement } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_completed add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_resource_partition value = var:zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_resource_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_t_resource_partition = var:zg361_pp_t_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_resource_conserved value = 1 } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_partition value = var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_partition add = var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_partition add = var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_partition = var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_conserved value = 1 } }
		zg361_pp_t_try_advance_02_effect = yes
	}
}

	}
}

	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied

				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner

				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial

				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$

				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
		}

			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
		}
	}
}

# 152 反馈可行动性评分: typed A/B/C write -> 经理反馈质量表按收件人一次性回写.
zg361_pp_m152_core_effect = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_cost_owner value = var:zg361_case_t_owner }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 }
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m152_receipt_active = 0
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				always = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				always = yes
			}
			else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				var:zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_available >= 1
				var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_available >= 1
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			always = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
			zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
			OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
			CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
			CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
			STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
			ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
			REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_t_revision
			TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_t_timeline_serial
			FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_t_feedback_revision
			LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_t_last_operation
			LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_t_last_choice
			RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m152_receipt_owner
			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_pp_m152_receipt_subject
			RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m152_receipt_cycle
			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m152_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_pp_m152_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_pp_m152_receipt_route
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			CHOICE = scope:zg361_pp_route
			OPERATION_ID = 152
			}
		}
		else = {
			# Route C is a policy-debt receipt, not a disguised business mutation.  It
			# deliberately does not call record_operation and therefore cannot change
			# the case revision, last operation, resource ledger, or typed payload.
			set_variable = { name = zg361_case_kernel_applied value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m152_receipt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m152_receipt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m152_receipt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m152_receipt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m152_receipt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m152_receipt_route value = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
					STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
					ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
					REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_t_revision
					AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_available
					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_reserved
					RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m152_operation_capacity_amount
					RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m152_operation_capacity_status
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m152_operation_capacity_owner
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m152_operation_capacity_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m152_operation_capacity_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
						CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
						REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_t_revision
						RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_reserved
						SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_settled
						RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m152_operation_capacity_amount
						RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m152_operation_capacity_status
						TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					}
				}
				zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
					STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
					ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
					REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_t_revision
					AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_available
					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_reserved
					RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m152_capacity_hours_amount
					RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m152_capacity_hours_status
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m152_capacity_hours_owner
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m152_capacity_hours_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m152_capacity_hours_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
						CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
						REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_t_revision
						RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_reserved
						SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_settled
						RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m152_capacity_hours_amount
						RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m152_capacity_hours_status
						TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }

				}
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }

				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
						var:zg361_pp_m152_operation_capacity_status = 1
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_pp_m152_operation_capacity_status = 2
					}
					else = { always = yes }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
						var:zg361_pp_m152_capacity_hours_status = 1
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_pp_m152_capacity_hours_status = 2
					}
					else = { always = yes }
					always = yes
					always = yes
				}
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m152_receipt_active value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m152_route value = scope:zg361_pp_route }
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m152_actionability_score value = 1 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_evidence_led add = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m152_actionability_score value = 2 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_political add = 1 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m152_deferred value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m152_policy_debt_due_days value = 90 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_policy_debt add = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m152_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_t_owner }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m152_object_subject value = this }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m152_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_t_cycle_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m152_object_case value = var:zg361_case_t_case_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m152_object_state value = 3 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m152_specificity value = 25 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m152_controllability value = 25 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m152_deadline_quality value = 25 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m152_resource_quality value = 25 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m152_total_score value = 100 }
					if = { limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m152_specificity value = 5 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m152_controllability value = 5 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m152_deadline_quality value = 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m152_resource_quality value = 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m152_total_score value = 10 } }

				}

				zg361_pp_m152_consume_effect = yes
				zg361_pp_m152_schedule_audit_1_effect = yes
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

zg361_pp_m152_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_pp_m152_receipt_owner
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = var:zg361_pp_m152_receipt_subject
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_pp_m152_receipt_cycle
				EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_pp_m152_receipt_case
				EXPECTED_STATE = var:zg361_pp_m152_receipt_state
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m152_receipt_active = 1
			var:zg361_pp_m152_consumed = 0
			has_variable = zg361_pp_m152_route
			always = yes
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m152_route = 3 } }
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m152_actionability_score
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m152_consumed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m152_consumer_revision value = var:zg361_case_t_revision }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m152_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m152_consumer_value value = var:zg361_pp_m152_actionability_score } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_completed add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_resource_partition value = var:zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_resource_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_t_resource_partition = var:zg361_pp_t_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_resource_conserved value = 1 } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_partition value = var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_partition add = var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_partition add = var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_partition = var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_conserved value = 1 } }
		zg361_pp_t_try_advance_03_effect = yes
	}
}

zg361_pp_m152_schedule_audit_1_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m152_audit_1_state = 0 var:zg361_pp_m152_receipt_active = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m152_audit_1_owner value = var:zg361_case_t_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m152_audit_1_subject value = this }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m152_audit_1_cycle value = var:zg361_case_t_cycle_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m152_audit_1_case value = var:zg361_case_t_case_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m152_audit_1_expected_state value = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m152_audit_1_state value = 1 }
		if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m152_route = 3 }
		trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.2152 days = 90 }
	}
	else = { trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.2152 days = 365 } }
	}
}

zg361_pp_m153_manager_apply_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	if = {
		limit = {
			root = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
			zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
			liege = root
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
		}
		zg361_pp_m153_core_effect = {
			ROUTE = $ROUTE$
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
		}
	}
}

# 153 反馈后行动项闭环: typed A/B/C write -> 行动时间线只接受一个终态回执.
zg361_pp_m153_core_effect = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_cost_owner value = var:zg361_case_t_owner }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 }
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial

				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m153_receipt_active = 0
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				always = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				always = yes
			}
			else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				var:zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_available >= 1
				var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_available >= 1
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			always = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
			zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
			OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject

			CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
			STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
			ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active

			TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_t_timeline_serial

			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_pp_m153_receipt_subject
			RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m153_receipt_cycle
			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m153_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_pp_m153_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_pp_m153_receipt_route
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			CHOICE = scope:zg361_pp_route
			OPERATION_ID = 153
			}
		}
		else = {
			# Route C is a policy-debt receipt, not a disguised business mutation.  It
			# deliberately does not call record_operation and therefore cannot change
			# the case revision, last operation, resource ledger, or typed payload.
			set_variable = { name = zg361_case_kernel_applied value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m153_receipt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m153_receipt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m153_receipt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m153_receipt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m153_receipt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m153_receipt_route value = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
					STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
					ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
					REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_t_revision
					AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_available
					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_reserved
					RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m153_operation_capacity_amount
					RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m153_operation_capacity_status
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m153_operation_capacity_owner
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m153_operation_capacity_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m153_operation_capacity_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$

zg361_pp_m153_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject

				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial

				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active

				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = var:zg361_pp_m153_receipt_subject
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_pp_m153_receipt_cycle
				EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_pp_m153_receipt_case
				EXPECTED_STATE = var:zg361_pp_m153_receipt_state
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m153_receipt_active = 1
			var:zg361_pp_m153_consumed = 0
			has_variable = zg361_pp_m153_route
			always = yes
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m153_route = 3 } }
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m153_action_item
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m153_consumed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m153_consumer_revision value = var:zg361_case_t_revision }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m153_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m153_consumer_value value = var:zg361_pp_m153_action_item } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_completed add = 1 }

		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_resource_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_t_resource_partition = var:zg361_pp_t_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_resource_conserved value = 1 } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_partition value = var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_partition add = var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_partition add = var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_settled }

	}
}

					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m154_minutes_mode value = 1 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_evidence_led add = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m154_minutes_mode value = 2 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_political add = 1 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m154_deferred value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m154_policy_debt_due_days value = 180 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_policy_debt add = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m154_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_t_owner }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m154_object_subject value = this }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m154_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_t_cycle_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m154_object_case value = var:zg361_case_t_case_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m154_object_state value = 3 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m154_minutes_id value = { value = var:zg361_case_t_case_serial multiply = 1000 add = 154 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m154_mode value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m154_version value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m154_append_only value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m154_evidence_index value = var:zg361_pp_t_frozen_evidence_hash }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m154_correction_revision value = 0 }
					if = { limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m154_mode value = 2 } }

				}

				zg361_pp_m154_consume_effect = yes
				zg361_pp_m154_schedule_audit_1_effect = yes
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

zg361_pp_m154_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_pp_m154_receipt_owner
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = var:zg361_pp_m154_receipt_subject
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_pp_m154_receipt_cycle
				EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_pp_m154_receipt_case
				EXPECTED_STATE = var:zg361_pp_m154_receipt_state
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m154_receipt_active = 1
			var:zg361_pp_m154_consumed = 0
			has_variable = zg361_pp_m154_route
			always = yes
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m154_route = 3 } }
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m154_minutes_mode
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m154_consumed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m154_consumer_revision value = var:zg361_case_t_revision }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m154_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m154_consumer_value value = var:zg361_pp_m154_minutes_mode } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_completed add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_resource_partition value = var:zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_resource_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_t_resource_partition = var:zg361_pp_t_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_resource_conserved value = 1 } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_partition value = var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_partition add = var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_partition add = var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_partition = var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_conserved value = 1 } }
		zg361_pp_t_try_advance_03_effect = yes
	}
}

zg361_pp_m154_schedule_audit_1_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m154_audit_1_state = 0 var:zg361_pp_m154_receipt_active = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m154_audit_1_owner value = var:zg361_case_t_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m154_audit_1_subject value = this }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m154_audit_1_cycle value = var:zg361_case_t_cycle_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m154_audit_1_case value = var:zg361_case_t_case_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m154_audit_1_expected_state value = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m154_audit_1_state value = 1 }
		if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m154_route = 3 }
		trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.2154 days = 180 }
	}
	else = { trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.2154 days = 7 } }
	}
}

zg361_pp_m155_manager_apply_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	if = {
		limit = {
			root = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
			zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
			liege = root
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
		}
		zg361_pp_m155_core_effect = {
			ROUTE = $ROUTE$
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
		}
	}
}

# 155 公开表扬与私下批评边界: typed A/B/C write -> 团队公告与私人反馈使用不同字段投影.
zg361_pp_m155_core_effect = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_cost_owner value = var:zg361_case_t_owner }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 }
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m155_receipt_active = 0
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				always = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				always = yes
			}
			else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				var:zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_available >= 1
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			always = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
			zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
			OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
			CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
			CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
			STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
			ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
			REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_t_revision
			TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_t_timeline_serial
			FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_t_feedback_revision
			LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_t_last_operation
			LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_t_last_choice
			RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m155_receipt_owner
			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_pp_m155_receipt_subject
			RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m155_receipt_cycle
			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m155_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_pp_m155_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_pp_m155_receipt_route
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			CHOICE = scope:zg361_pp_route
			OPERATION_ID = 155
			}
		}
		else = {
			# Route C is a policy-debt receipt, not a disguised business mutation.  It
			# deliberately does not call record_operation and therefore cannot change
			# the case revision, last operation, resource ledger, or typed payload.
			set_variable = { name = zg361_case_kernel_applied value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m155_receipt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m155_receipt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m155_receipt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m155_receipt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m155_receipt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m155_receipt_route value = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
					STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
					ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
					REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_t_revision
					AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_available
					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_reserved
					RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m155_operation_capacity_amount
					RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m155_operation_capacity_status
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m155_operation_capacity_owner
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m155_operation_capacity_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m155_operation_capacity_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
						CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
						REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_t_revision
						RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_reserved
						SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_settled
						RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m155_operation_capacity_amount
						RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m155_operation_capacity_status
						TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }

				}
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }

				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
						var:zg361_pp_m155_operation_capacity_status = 1
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_pp_m155_operation_capacity_status = 2
					}
					else = { always = yes }
					always = yes
					always = yes
				}
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m155_receipt_active value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m155_route value = scope:zg361_pp_route }
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m155_public_private_boundary value = 1 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_evidence_led add = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m155_public_private_boundary value = 2 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_political add = 1 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m155_deferred value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m155_policy_debt_due_days value = 180 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_policy_debt add = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m155_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_t_owner }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m155_object_subject value = this }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m155_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_t_cycle_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m155_object_case value = var:zg361_case_t_case_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m155_object_state value = 4 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m155_public_achievement_fields value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m155_public_grade_fields value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m155_private_sensitive_fields value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m155_subject_projection_acl value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m155_team_projection_acl value = 2 }
					if = { limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 } add_stress = minor_stress_gain set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m155_public_grade_fields value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m155_public_shaming value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m155_retaliation_risk value = 1 } }

				}

				zg361_pp_m155_consume_effect = yes
				zg361_pp_m155_schedule_audit_1_effect = yes
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# 156 团队结果说明会: typed A/B/C write -> 政策面板读取说明会收据或流言风险.
zg361_pp_m156_core_effect = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_cost_owner value = var:zg361_case_t_owner }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 }
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$

					REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_t_revision
					AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_available
					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_reserved
					RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m156_capacity_hours_amount
					RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m156_capacity_hours_status
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m156_capacity_hours_owner
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m156_capacity_hours_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m156_capacity_hours_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$

					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$

					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).

zg361_pp_m156_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject

				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_pp_m156_receipt_owner
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = var:zg361_pp_m156_receipt_subject
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_pp_m156_receipt_cycle
				EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_pp_m156_receipt_case
				EXPECTED_STATE = var:zg361_pp_m156_receipt_state
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m156_receipt_active = 1
			var:zg361_pp_m156_consumed = 0
			has_variable = zg361_pp_m156_route
			always = yes
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m156_route = 3 } }
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m156_team_briefing
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m156_consumed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m156_consumer_revision value = var:zg361_case_t_revision }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m156_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m156_consumer_value value = var:zg361_pp_m156_team_briefing } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_completed add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_resource_partition value = var:zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_t_operation_capacity_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_resource_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_t_resource_partition = var:zg361_pp_t_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_resource_conserved value = 1 } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_partition value = var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_partition add = var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_partition add = var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_partition = var:zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_conserved value = 1 } }
		zg361_pp_t_try_advance_04_effect = yes
	}
}

				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
						CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_u_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_u_active
						REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_u_revision
						RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_reserved
						SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_settled
						RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m157_operation_capacity_amount
						RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m157_operation_capacity_status
						TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					}
				}
				zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial
					STATE_VAR = zg361_case_u_state
					ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_u_active
					REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_u_revision
					AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_u_nomination_slot_available
					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_u_nomination_slot_reserved
					RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m157_nomination_slot_amount
					RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m157_nomination_slot_status
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m157_nomination_slot_owner
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m157_nomination_slot_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m157_nomination_slot_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
						CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_u_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_u_active
						REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_u_revision
						RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_u_nomination_slot_reserved
						SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_u_nomination_slot_settled
						RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m157_nomination_slot_amount
						RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m157_nomination_slot_status
						TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }

				}
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }

				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
						var:zg361_pp_m157_operation_capacity_status = 1
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_pp_m157_operation_capacity_status = 2
					}
					else = { always = yes }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
						var:zg361_pp_m157_nomination_slot_status = 1
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_pp_m157_nomination_slot_status = 2
					}
					else = { always = yes }
					always = yes
					always = yes
				}
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m157_receipt_active value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m157_route value = scope:zg361_pp_route }
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m157_nomination_access value = 1 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_evidence_led add = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m157_nomination_access value = 2 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_political add = 1 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m157_deferred value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m157_policy_debt_due_days value = 90 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_policy_debt add = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m157_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_u_owner }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m157_object_subject value = this }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m157_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_u_cycle_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m157_object_case value = var:zg361_case_u_case_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m157_object_state value = 1 }
					save_temporary_scope_as = zg361_pp_nomination_candidate
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m157_eligibility_grade value = var:zg361_pp_u_frozen_grade }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m157_eligible_at_nomination value = var:zg361_pp_u_candidate_eligible }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m157_packet_candidate value = this }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m157_packet_owner value = var:zg361_case_u_owner }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m157_packet_cycle value = var:zg361_case_u_cycle_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m157_packet_case value = var:zg361_case_u_case_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m157_packet_source value = scope:zg361_pp_route }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m157_packet_active value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m157_packet_status value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m157_sponsor_bound value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m157_manager_opinion_bound value = 1 }
					var:zg361_case_u_owner = {
						if = {
							limit = {
								has_variable = zg361_pp_u_shelving_candidate
								var:zg361_pp_u_shelving_candidate = scope:zg361_pp_nomination_candidate
								var:zg361_pp_u_shelving_active = 1
							}
							set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_shelving_nominated value = 1 }
							set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_shelving_active value = 0 }
						}
					}

				}

				zg361_pp_m157_consume_effect = yes
				zg361_pp_m157_schedule_audit_1_effect = yes
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

zg361_pp_m157_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_u_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_u_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_pp_m157_receipt_owner
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = var:zg361_pp_m157_receipt_subject
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_pp_m157_receipt_cycle
				EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_pp_m157_receipt_case
				EXPECTED_STATE = var:zg361_pp_m157_receipt_state
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m157_receipt_active = 1
			var:zg361_pp_m157_consumed = 0
			has_variable = zg361_pp_m157_route
			always = yes
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m157_route = 3 } }
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m157_nomination_access
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m157_consumed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m157_consumer_revision value = var:zg361_case_u_revision }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m157_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m157_consumer_value value = var:zg361_pp_m157_nomination_access } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_completed add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_partition value = var:zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_u_resource_partition = var:zg361_pp_u_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_conserved value = 1 } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_nomination_slot_partition value = var:zg361_pp_u_nomination_slot_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_nomination_slot_partition add = var:zg361_pp_u_nomination_slot_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_nomination_slot_partition add = var:zg361_pp_u_nomination_slot_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_nomination_slot_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_u_nomination_slot_partition = var:zg361_pp_u_nomination_slot_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_nomination_slot_conserved value = 1 } }
		zg361_pp_u_try_advance_01_effect = yes
	}
}

zg361_pp_m157_schedule_audit_1_effect = {

		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m157_audit_1_state = 0 var:zg361_pp_m157_receipt_active = 1 }

	}
}

				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
		}

			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
		}
	}

# 158 主管提名额度: typed A/B/C write -> 额度账校验已用、归还与剩余恒等.
zg361_pp_m158_core_effect = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_cost_owner value = var:zg361_case_u_owner }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 }
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_u_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_u_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m158_receipt_active = 0
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				var:zg361_pp_m157_packet_active = 1
				var:zg361_pp_m157_packet_status = 1
				var:zg361_pp_m157_packet_candidate = this
				var:zg361_pp_m157_receipt_owner = var:zg361_case_u_owner
				var:zg361_pp_m157_receipt_cycle = var:zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
				var:zg361_pp_m157_receipt_case = var:zg361_case_u_case_serial
				OR = {
					var:zg361_pp_m157_nomination_slot_status = 1
					var:zg361_pp_m157_nomination_slot_status = 2
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				var:zg361_pp_m157_packet_active = 1
				var:zg361_pp_m157_packet_status = 1
				var:zg361_pp_m157_packet_candidate = this
				var:zg361_pp_m157_receipt_owner = var:zg361_case_u_owner
				var:zg361_pp_m157_receipt_cycle = var:zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
				var:zg361_pp_m157_receipt_case = var:zg361_case_u_case_serial
				OR = {
					var:zg361_pp_m157_nomination_slot_status = 1
					var:zg361_pp_m157_nomination_slot_status = 2
				}
			}
			else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				var:zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_available >= 1
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			always = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
			zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
			OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
			CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
			CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial
			STATE_VAR = zg361_case_u_state
			ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_u_active
			REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_u_revision
			TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_u_timeline_serial
			FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_u_feedback_revision
			LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_u_last_operation
			LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_u_last_choice
			RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m158_receipt_owner
			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_pp_m158_receipt_subject
			RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m158_receipt_cycle
			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m158_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_pp_m158_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_pp_m158_receipt_route
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			CHOICE = scope:zg361_pp_route
			OPERATION_ID = 158
			}
		}
		else = {
			# Route C is a policy-debt receipt, not a disguised business mutation.  It
			# deliberately does not call record_operation and therefore cannot change
			# the case revision, last operation, resource ledger, or typed payload.
			set_variable = { name = zg361_case_kernel_applied value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m158_receipt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m158_receipt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m158_receipt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m158_receipt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m158_receipt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m158_receipt_route value = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial

					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_reserved
					RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m158_operation_capacity_amount
					RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m158_operation_capacity_status
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m158_operation_capacity_owner
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m158_operation_capacity_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m158_operation_capacity_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
						CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_u_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_u_active

						SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_settled
						RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m158_operation_capacity_amount
						RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m158_operation_capacity_status
						TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$

						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
						var:zg361_pp_m158_operation_capacity_status = 1
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_pp_m158_operation_capacity_status = 2
					}
					else = { always = yes }
					always = yes
					always = yes
				}
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m158_receipt_active value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m158_route value = scope:zg361_pp_route }
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }

				}
