					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_political add = 1 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m158_deferred value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m158_policy_debt_due_days value = 90 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_policy_debt add = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m158_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_u_owner }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m158_object_subject value = this }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m158_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_u_cycle_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m158_object_case value = var:zg361_case_u_case_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m158_object_state value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m158_packet_candidate_consumed value = var:zg361_pp_m157_packet_candidate }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m158_packet_case_consumed value = var:zg361_pp_m157_receipt_case }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m158_quota_total value = var:zg361_pp_u_nomination_slot_authorized }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m158_quota_used value = var:zg361_pp_u_nomination_slot_reserved }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m158_quota_used add = var:zg361_pp_u_nomination_slot_settled }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m158_quota_remaining value = var:zg361_pp_u_nomination_slot_available }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m158_quota_returned value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m158_quota_partition value = var:zg361_pp_m158_quota_used }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m158_quota_partition add = var:zg361_pp_m158_quota_remaining }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m158_quota_partition add = var:zg361_pp_m158_quota_returned }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m158_quota_conserved value = 0 }
					if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_m158_quota_partition = var:zg361_pp_m158_quota_total } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m158_quota_conserved value = 1 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m158_rank value = 1 }

				}

				zg361_pp_m158_consume_effect = yes
				zg361_pp_m158_schedule_audit_1_effect = yes
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

zg361_pp_m158_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_u_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_u_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_pp_m158_receipt_owner
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = var:zg361_pp_m158_receipt_subject
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_pp_m158_receipt_cycle
				EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_pp_m158_receipt_case
				EXPECTED_STATE = var:zg361_pp_m158_receipt_state
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m158_receipt_active = 1
			var:zg361_pp_m158_consumed = 0
			has_variable = zg361_pp_m158_route
			always = yes
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m158_route = 3 } }
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m158_nomination_quota
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m158_consumed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m158_consumer_revision value = var:zg361_case_u_revision }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m158_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m158_consumer_value value = var:zg361_pp_m158_nomination_quota } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_completed add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_partition value = var:zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_u_resource_partition = var:zg361_pp_u_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_conserved value = 1 } }

		zg361_pp_u_try_advance_01_effect = yes
	}
}

zg361_pp_m158_schedule_audit_1_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m158_audit_1_state = 0 var:zg361_pp_m158_receipt_active = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m158_audit_1_owner value = var:zg361_case_u_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m158_audit_1_subject value = this }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m158_audit_1_cycle value = var:zg361_case_u_cycle_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m158_audit_1_case value = var:zg361_case_u_case_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m158_audit_1_expected_state value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m158_audit_1_state value = 1 }
		if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m158_route = 3 }
		trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.2158 days = 90 }
	}
	else = { trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.2158 days = 30 } }
	}
}

zg361_pp_m159_manager_apply_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	if = {
		limit = {
			root = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
			zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
			liege = root
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_u_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_u_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
		}
		zg361_pp_m159_core_effect = {
			ROUTE = $ROUTE$
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
		}
	}
}

# 159 雪藏明星不提名: typed A/B/C write -> 逾期审计每周期只扣一次经理人才分.
zg361_pp_m159_core_effect = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_cost_owner value = var:zg361_case_u_owner }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 }
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_u_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_u_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m159_receipt_active = 0
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				always = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				always = yes
			}
			else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				var:zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_available >= 1
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			always = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
			zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
			OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
			CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
			CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial
			STATE_VAR = zg361_case_u_state
			ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_u_active
			REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_u_revision
			TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_u_timeline_serial
			FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_u_feedback_revision
			LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_u_last_operation
			LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_u_last_choice
			RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m159_receipt_owner
			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_pp_m159_receipt_subject
			RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m159_receipt_cycle
			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m159_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_pp_m159_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_pp_m159_receipt_route
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			CHOICE = scope:zg361_pp_route
			OPERATION_ID = 159
			}
		}
		else = {
			# Route C is a policy-debt receipt, not a disguised business mutation.  It
			# deliberately does not call record_operation and therefore cannot change
			# the case revision, last operation, resource ledger, or typed payload.
			set_variable = { name = zg361_case_kernel_applied value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m159_receipt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m159_receipt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m159_receipt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m159_receipt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m159_receipt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m159_receipt_route value = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial
					STATE_VAR = zg361_case_u_state
					ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_u_active
					REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_u_revision
					AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_available
					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_reserved
					RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m159_operation_capacity_amount
					RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m159_operation_capacity_status
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m159_operation_capacity_owner
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m159_operation_capacity_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m159_operation_capacity_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
						CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_u_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_u_active
						REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_u_revision
						RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_reserved
						SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_settled
						RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m159_operation_capacity_amount
						RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m159_operation_capacity_status
						TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }

				}
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }

				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
						var:zg361_pp_m159_operation_capacity_status = 1
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_pp_m159_operation_capacity_status = 2
					}
					else = { always = yes }
					always = yes
					always = yes
				}
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m159_receipt_active value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m159_route value = scope:zg361_pp_route }
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m159_shelved_star value = 1 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_evidence_led add = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m159_shelved_star value = 2 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_political add = 1 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m159_deferred value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m159_policy_debt_due_days value = 90 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_policy_debt add = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m159_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_u_owner }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m159_object_subject value = this }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m159_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_u_cycle_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m159_object_case value = var:zg361_case_u_case_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m159_object_state value = 1 }
					save_temporary_scope_as = zg361_pp_shelved_candidate
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m159_successor_plan value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m159_nomination_due_cycles value = 1 }
					var:zg361_case_u_owner = {
						set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_shelving_candidate value = scope:zg361_pp_shelved_candidate }
						set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_shelving_owner value = this }
						set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_shelving_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_review_serial add = 1 } }
						set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_shelving_last_penalty_cycle value = 0 }
						set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_shelving_resource value = 1 }
						if = {
							limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
							# #157 already nominated this subject on the evidence-led path.
							set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_shelving_active value = 0 }
							set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_shelving_nominated value = 1 }
						}
						else = {
							# Political shelving persists on the manager and is charged once per
							# later overdue cycle until #157 nominates this same character.
							set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_shelving_active value = 1 }
							set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_shelving_nominated value = 0 }
						}
					}
					if = { limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m159_successor_plan value = 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m159_talent_debt value = 1 } }

				}

				zg361_pp_m159_consume_effect = yes
				zg361_pp_m159_schedule_audit_1_effect = yes
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# 160 部门预审淘汰赛: typed A/B/C write -> 预审队列只把真实席位数量的包送进答辩.
zg361_pp_m160_core_effect = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_cost_owner value = var:zg361_case_u_owner }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 }
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner

			}

				has_variable = zg361_pp_m160_prescreen_rubric
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }

		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_reserved }

# 161 “陪跑包”与虚假竞争: typed A/B/C write -> 经理公平信用和主推包合法性消费陪跑识别.
zg361_pp_m161_core_effect = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_cost_owner value = var:zg361_case_u_owner }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 }
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_u_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_u_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m161_receipt_active = 0
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				var:zg361_pp_m157_packet_active = 1
				var:zg361_pp_m157_packet_status = 1
				var:zg361_pp_m157_packet_candidate = this
				var:zg361_pp_m157_receipt_owner = var:zg361_case_u_owner
				var:zg361_pp_m157_receipt_cycle = var:zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
				var:zg361_pp_m157_receipt_case = var:zg361_case_u_case_serial
				OR = {
					var:zg361_pp_m157_nomination_slot_status = 1
					var:zg361_pp_m157_nomination_slot_status = 2
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				var:zg361_pp_m157_packet_active = 1
				var:zg361_pp_m157_packet_status = 1
				var:zg361_pp_m157_packet_candidate = this
				var:zg361_pp_m157_receipt_owner = var:zg361_case_u_owner
				var:zg361_pp_m157_receipt_cycle = var:zg361_case_u_cycle_serial

				has_variable = zg361_pp_m161_filler_candidate
				NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m161_filler_candidate = this }
			}
			else = { always = yes }

				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }

				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }

				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				var:zg361_pp_u_nomination_slot_available >= 1

zg361_pp_m161_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {

				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject

				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_u_active

				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = var:zg361_pp_m161_receipt_subject
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_pp_m161_receipt_cycle
				EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_pp_m161_receipt_case
				EXPECTED_STATE = var:zg361_pp_m161_receipt_state
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m161_receipt_active = 1
			var:zg361_pp_m161_consumed = 0
			has_variable = zg361_pp_m161_route
			always = yes
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m161_route = 3 } }
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m161_sham_competition
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m161_consumed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m161_consumer_revision value = var:zg361_case_u_revision }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m161_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m161_consumer_value value = var:zg361_pp_m161_sham_competition } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_completed add = 1 }

		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_settled }

	}
}

zg361_pp_m162_manager_apply_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied

				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial

				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
		}
		zg361_pp_m162_core_effect = {
			ROUTE = $ROUTE$
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$

			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
		}
	}
}

# 162 资历门槛例外申请: typed A/B/C write -> 破格额度账与后续能力评审保持分离.
zg361_pp_m162_core_effect = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_cost_owner value = var:zg361_case_u_owner }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 }
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_u_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_u_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m162_receipt_active = 0
			trigger_if = {

					REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_u_revision

			}

				has_variable = zg361_pp_m162_tenure_exception

		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_completed add = 1 }

		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_settled }

		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_u_resource_partition = var:zg361_pp_u_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_conserved value = 1 } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_tenure_exception_slot_partition value = var:zg361_pp_u_tenure_exception_slot_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_tenure_exception_slot_partition add = var:zg361_pp_u_tenure_exception_slot_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_tenure_exception_slot_partition add = var:zg361_pp_u_tenure_exception_slot_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_tenure_exception_slot_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_u_tenure_exception_slot_partition = var:zg361_pp_u_tenure_exception_slot_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_tenure_exception_slot_conserved value = 1 } }
		zg361_pp_u_try_advance_03_effect = yes
	}

				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }

			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			CHOICE = scope:zg361_pp_route
			OPERATION_ID = 163
			}
		}
		else = {
			# Route C is a policy-debt receipt, not a disguised business mutation.  It
			# deliberately does not call record_operation and therefore cannot change
			# the case revision, last operation, resource ledger, or typed payload.
			set_variable = { name = zg361_case_kernel_applied value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m163_receipt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m163_receipt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m163_receipt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m163_receipt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m163_receipt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m163_receipt_route value = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial
					STATE_VAR = zg361_case_u_state
					ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_u_active
					REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_u_revision
					AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_available
					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_reserved
					RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m163_operation_capacity_amount
					RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m163_operation_capacity_status
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m163_operation_capacity_owner
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m163_operation_capacity_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m163_operation_capacity_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
						CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_u_cycle_serial

						TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					}
				}

					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }

				}
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }

				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
						var:zg361_pp_m163_operation_capacity_status = 1
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_pp_m163_operation_capacity_status = 2
					}
					else = { always = yes }
					always = yes
					always = yes
				}

				}
				if = {

					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m163_object_subject value = this }

				zg361_pp_m163_schedule_audit_1_effect = yes

		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_u_resource_partition = var:zg361_pp_u_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_conserved value = 1 } }

		zg361_pp_u_try_advance_02_effect = yes
	}
}

		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m164_consumer_revision value = var:zg361_case_u_revision }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m164_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m164_consumer_value value = var:zg361_pp_m164_cross_team_evidence } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_completed add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_partition value = var:zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_u_resource_partition = var:zg361_pp_u_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_conserved value = 1 } }

		zg361_pp_u_try_advance_02_effect = yes
	}
}

# 165 “先干到下一级”试岗证据: typed A/B/C write -> 预审消费试岗验收回执，不改当期绩效.
zg361_pp_m165_core_effect = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_cost_owner value = var:zg361_case_u_owner }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 }
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject

				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m165_receipt_active = 0
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				var:zg361_pp_m157_packet_active = 1
				var:zg361_pp_m157_packet_status = 1
				var:zg361_pp_m157_packet_candidate = this
				var:zg361_pp_m157_receipt_owner = var:zg361_case_u_owner

					var:zg361_pp_m157_nomination_slot_status = 1
					var:zg361_pp_m157_nomination_slot_status = 2
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				var:zg361_pp_m157_packet_active = 1
				var:zg361_pp_m157_packet_status = 1
				var:zg361_pp_m157_packet_candidate = this
				var:zg361_pp_m157_receipt_owner = var:zg361_case_u_owner
				var:zg361_pp_m157_receipt_cycle = var:zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
				var:zg361_pp_m157_receipt_case = var:zg361_case_u_case_serial
				OR = {
					var:zg361_pp_m157_nomination_slot_status = 1
					var:zg361_pp_m157_nomination_slot_status = 2
				}
			}
			else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }

				var:zg361_pp_u_capacity_hours_available >= 1

				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				var:zg361_pp_cost_owner = {
					government_has_flag = government_has_treasury
					treasury >= 5
					gold >= 5
				}
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
			zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {

			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject

			CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial

			LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_u_last_choice

			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_pp_m165_receipt_subject

			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			CHOICE = scope:zg361_pp_route
			OPERATION_ID = 165
			}
		}
		else = {
			# Route C is a policy-debt receipt, not a disguised business mutation.  It
			# deliberately does not call record_operation and therefore cannot change
			# the case revision, last operation, resource ledger, or typed payload.
			set_variable = { name = zg361_case_kernel_applied value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m165_receipt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m165_receipt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m165_receipt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m165_receipt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m165_receipt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m165_receipt_route value = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
			if = {

				zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject

					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject

						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_u_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_u_active

						RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_reserved
						SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_settled

						RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m165_operation_capacity_status
						TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$

						TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					}
				}
				zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial
					STATE_VAR = zg361_case_u_state
					ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_u_active
					REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_u_revision
					AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_u_capacity_hours_available
					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_u_capacity_hours_reserved
					RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m165_capacity_hours_amount
					RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m165_capacity_hours_status
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m165_capacity_hours_owner
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m165_capacity_hours_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m165_capacity_hours_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
						CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_u_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_u_active
						REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_u_revision
						RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_u_capacity_hours_reserved
						SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_u_capacity_hours_settled

zg361_pp_m165_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_u_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_u_active

				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = var:zg361_pp_m165_receipt_subject
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_pp_m165_receipt_cycle
				EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_pp_m165_receipt_case
				EXPECTED_STATE = var:zg361_pp_m165_receipt_state
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m165_receipt_active = 1
			var:zg361_pp_m165_consumed = 0
			has_variable = zg361_pp_m165_route
			always = yes
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m165_route = 3 } }
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m165_next_level_trial
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m165_consumed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m165_consumer_revision value = var:zg361_case_u_revision }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m165_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m165_consumer_value value = var:zg361_pp_m165_next_level_trial } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_completed add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_partition value = var:zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_u_resource_partition = var:zg361_pp_u_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_conserved value = 1 } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_capacity_hours_partition value = var:zg361_pp_u_capacity_hours_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_capacity_hours_partition add = var:zg361_pp_u_capacity_hours_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_capacity_hours_partition add = var:zg361_pp_u_capacity_hours_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_capacity_hours_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_u_capacity_hours_partition = var:zg361_pp_u_capacity_hours_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_capacity_hours_conserved value = 1 } }
		zg361_pp_u_try_advance_02_effect = yes
	}
}

# The assessed official may respond only to their own packet.  This grants no
# cohort, nomination, panel, PIP-initiation or assessment authority.

				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_u_active
			}
			var:zg361_case_u_state = 3
			NOT = { has_variable = zg361_pp_m166_subject_response }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m166_subject_response value = scope:zg361_pp_subject_route }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m166_withdraw_intent value = 1 }
		zg361_pp_m166_core_effect = {
			ROUTE = 1
			TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_u_owner

			TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
			TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_u_case_serial
			TICKET_STATE = 3
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 }

			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				var:zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_available >= 1
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				always = yes

			limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
			zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
			OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
			CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
			CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial
			STATE_VAR = zg361_case_u_state

		else = {

					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m166_operation_capacity_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m166_operation_capacity_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$

					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}

						var:zg361_pp_m166_operation_capacity_status = 2

					else = { always = yes }
					always = yes
					always = yes
				}
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m166_receipt_active value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m166_route value = scope:zg361_pp_route }

					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m166_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_u_owner }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m166_object_subject value = this }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m166_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_u_cycle_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m166_object_case value = var:zg361_case_u_case_serial }

zg361_pp_m166_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {

				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_u_active

				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = var:zg361_pp_m166_receipt_subject
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_pp_m166_receipt_cycle
				EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_pp_m166_receipt_case
				EXPECTED_STATE = var:zg361_pp_m166_receipt_state
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m166_receipt_active = 1
			var:zg361_pp_m166_consumed = 0
			has_variable = zg361_pp_m166_route

				limit = { var:zg361_pp_m166_route = 1 }
				var:zg361_pp_m166_nomination_slot_refunded = 1
				var:zg361_pp_m166_packet_active_after = 0
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }

				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m166_route = 3 } }
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m166_packet_withdrawal
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m166_consumed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m166_consumer_revision value = var:zg361_case_u_revision }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m166_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m166_consumer_value value = var:zg361_pp_m166_packet_withdrawal } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_completed add = 1 }

		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_u_resource_partition = var:zg361_pp_u_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_conserved value = 1 } }

		zg361_pp_u_try_advance_03_effect = yes
	}
}

			LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_u_last_choice
			RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m167_receipt_owner
			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_pp_m167_receipt_subject
			RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m167_receipt_cycle
			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m167_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_pp_m167_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_pp_m167_receipt_route
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			CHOICE = scope:zg361_pp_route
			OPERATION_ID = 167
			}
		}
		else = {
			# Route C is a policy-debt receipt, not a disguised business mutation.  It
			# deliberately does not call record_operation and therefore cannot change
			# the case revision, last operation, resource ledger, or typed payload.
			set_variable = { name = zg361_case_kernel_applied value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m167_receipt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m167_receipt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m167_receipt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m167_receipt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m167_receipt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m167_receipt_route value = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial
					STATE_VAR = zg361_case_u_state
					ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_u_active
					REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_u_revision
					AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_available
					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_reserved
					RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m167_operation_capacity_amount
					RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m167_operation_capacity_status
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m167_operation_capacity_owner
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m167_operation_capacity_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m167_operation_capacity_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
						CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_u_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_u_active
						REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_u_revision
						RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_reserved
						SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_settled
						RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m167_operation_capacity_amount
						RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m167_operation_capacity_status
						TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }

				}
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }

				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
						var:zg361_pp_m167_operation_capacity_status = 1
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_pp_m167_operation_capacity_status = 2
					}
					else = { always = yes }
					always = yes
					always = yes
				}
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m167_receipt_active value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m167_route value = scope:zg361_pp_route }
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m167_sponsor_credit value = 1 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_evidence_led add = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m167_sponsor_credit value = 2 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_political add = 1 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m167_deferred value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m167_policy_debt_due_days value = 90 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_policy_debt add = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m167_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_u_owner }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m167_object_subject value = this }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m167_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_u_cycle_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m167_object_case value = var:zg361_case_u_case_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m167_object_state value = 4 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m167_sponsor_strength value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m167_observation_id value = { value = var:zg361_case_u_case_serial multiply = 1000 add = 167 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m167_observation_candidate value = var:zg361_pp_m160_packet_candidate_consumed }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m167_observation_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_u_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m167_observation_settled value = 0 }
					if = { limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m167_sponsor_strength value = 3 } }

				}

				zg361_pp_m167_consume_effect = yes
				zg361_pp_m167_schedule_audit_1_effect = yes
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

zg361_pp_m167_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_u_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_u_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_pp_m167_receipt_owner
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = var:zg361_pp_m167_receipt_subject
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_pp_m167_receipt_cycle
				EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_pp_m167_receipt_case
				EXPECTED_STATE = var:zg361_pp_m167_receipt_state
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m167_receipt_active = 1
			var:zg361_pp_m167_consumed = 0
			has_variable = zg361_pp_m167_route
			always = yes
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m167_route = 3 } }
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m167_sponsor_credit
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m167_consumed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m167_consumer_revision value = var:zg361_case_u_revision }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m167_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m167_consumer_value value = var:zg361_pp_m167_sponsor_credit } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_completed add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_partition value = var:zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_u_resource_partition = var:zg361_pp_u_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_conserved value = 1 } }

		zg361_pp_u_try_advance_04_effect = yes
	}
}

zg361_pp_m167_schedule_audit_1_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m167_audit_1_state = 0 var:zg361_pp_m167_receipt_active = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m167_audit_1_owner value = var:zg361_case_u_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m167_audit_1_subject value = this }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m167_audit_1_cycle value = var:zg361_case_u_cycle_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m167_audit_1_case value = var:zg361_case_u_case_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m167_audit_1_expected_state value = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m167_audit_1_state value = 1 }
		if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m167_route = 3 }
		trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.2167 days = 90 }
	}
	else = { trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.2167 days = 365 } }
	}
}

zg361_pp_m168_manager_apply_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	if = {
		limit = {
			root = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
			zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
			liege = root
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_u_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_u_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
		}
		zg361_pp_m168_core_effect = {
			ROUTE = $ROUTE$
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
		}
	}
}

# 168 经理提名命中率: typed A/B/C write -> 上司下一轮辅导或收紧额度时消费成熟样本.
zg361_pp_m168_core_effect = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_cost_owner value = var:zg361_case_u_owner }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 }
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial

				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m168_receipt_active = 0
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m160_prescreen_pass
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m167_observation_id
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m160_prescreen_pass
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m167_observation_id
			}
			else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				var:zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_available >= 1
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			always = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
			zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
			OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
			CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
			CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial

			LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_u_last_choice

			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_pp_m168_receipt_subject
			RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m168_receipt_cycle
			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m168_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_pp_m168_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_pp_m168_receipt_route
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			CHOICE = scope:zg361_pp_route
			OPERATION_ID = 168
			}
		}
		else = {
			# Route C is a policy-debt receipt, not a disguised business mutation.  It
			# deliberately does not call record_operation and therefore cannot change
			# the case revision, last operation, resource ledger, or typed payload.
			set_variable = { name = zg361_case_kernel_applied value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m168_receipt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m168_receipt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m168_receipt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m168_receipt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m168_receipt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m168_receipt_route value = 3 }

			limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial
					STATE_VAR = zg361_case_u_state
					ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_u_active
					REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_u_revision
					AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_available
					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_reserved
					RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m168_operation_capacity_amount
					RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m168_operation_capacity_status
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m168_operation_capacity_owner
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m168_operation_capacity_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m168_operation_capacity_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}
				if = {

					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).

					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {

						RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_reserved
						SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_settled
						RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m168_operation_capacity_amount
						RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m168_operation_capacity_status
						TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$

					}

				}

				}

	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {

				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_u_state

				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = var:zg361_pp_m168_receipt_subject
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_pp_m168_receipt_cycle
				EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_pp_m168_receipt_case
				EXPECTED_STATE = var:zg361_pp_m168_receipt_state
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m168_receipt_active = 1
			var:zg361_pp_m168_consumed = 0
			has_variable = zg361_pp_m168_route
			always = yes
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m168_route = 3 } }
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m168_manager_hit_rate
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m168_consumed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m168_consumer_revision value = var:zg361_case_u_revision }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m168_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m168_consumer_value value = var:zg361_pp_m168_manager_hit_rate } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_completed add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_partition value = var:zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_u_resource_partition = var:zg361_pp_u_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_conserved value = 1 } }

		zg361_pp_u_try_advance_04_effect = yes
	}
}

# 169 评委专业匹配: typed A/B/C write -> 答辩计分器按事前权重消费每席评分.
zg361_pp_m169_core_effect = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_cost_owner value = var:zg361_case_v_owner }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 }
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_v_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_v_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m169_receipt_active = 0
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				var:zg361_pp_m160_prescreen_pass = 1
				var:zg361_pp_m160_packet_candidate_consumed = this
				var:zg361_pp_m160_promotion_slot_status = 2
				has_variable = zg361_pp_v_source_packet_case
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				var:zg361_pp_m160_prescreen_pass = 1
				var:zg361_pp_m160_packet_candidate_consumed = this
				var:zg361_pp_m160_promotion_slot_status = 2
				has_variable = zg361_pp_v_source_packet_case
			}
			else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				var:zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_available >= 1
				var:zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_available >= 1
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			always = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
			zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
			OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
			CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
			CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial
			STATE_VAR = zg361_case_v_state
			ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_v_active
			REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_v_revision
			TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_v_timeline_serial
			FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_v_feedback_revision
			LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_v_last_operation
			LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_v_last_choice
			RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m169_receipt_owner
			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_pp_m169_receipt_subject
			RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m169_receipt_cycle
			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m169_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_pp_m169_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_pp_m169_receipt_route
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			CHOICE = scope:zg361_pp_route
			OPERATION_ID = 169
			}
		}
		else = {
			# Route C is a policy-debt receipt, not a disguised business mutation.  It
			# deliberately does not call record_operation and therefore cannot change
			# the case revision, last operation, resource ledger, or typed payload.
			set_variable = { name = zg361_case_kernel_applied value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m169_receipt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m169_receipt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m169_receipt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m169_receipt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m169_receipt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m169_receipt_route value = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial
					STATE_VAR = zg361_case_v_state
					ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_v_active
					REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_v_revision
					AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_available
					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_reserved
					RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m169_operation_capacity_amount
					RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m169_operation_capacity_status
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m169_operation_capacity_owner
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m169_operation_capacity_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m169_operation_capacity_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
						CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_v_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_v_active
						REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_v_revision
						RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_reserved
						SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_settled
						RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m169_operation_capacity_amount
						RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m169_operation_capacity_status
						TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					}
				}
				zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial
					STATE_VAR = zg361_case_v_state
					ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_v_active
					REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_v_revision
					AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_available
					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_reserved
					RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m169_panel_vote_amount
					RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m169_panel_vote_status
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m169_panel_vote_owner
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m169_panel_vote_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m169_panel_vote_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
						CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_v_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_v_active
						REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_v_revision
						RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_reserved
						SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_settled
						RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m169_panel_vote_amount
						RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m169_panel_vote_status
						TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }

				}
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }

				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
						var:zg361_pp_m169_operation_capacity_status = 1
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_pp_m169_operation_capacity_status = 2
					}
					else = { always = yes }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
						var:zg361_pp_m169_panel_vote_status = 1
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_pp_m169_panel_vote_status = 2
					}
					else = { always = yes }
					always = yes
					always = yes
				}
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m169_receipt_active value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m169_route value = scope:zg361_pp_route }

					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m169_expertise_mix value = 1 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_evidence_led add = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m169_expertise_mix value = 2 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_political add = 1 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m169_deferred value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m169_policy_debt_due_days value = 90 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_policy_debt add = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m169_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_v_owner }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m169_object_subject value = this }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m169_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_v_cycle_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m169_object_case value = var:zg361_case_v_case_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m169_object_state value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m169_expert_weight value = 60 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m169_external_weight value = 40 }
					if = { limit = { has_variable = zg361_pp_m163_window_cycles } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m169_observation_window_consumed value = var:zg361_pp_m163_window_cycles } }
					if = { limit = { has_variable = zg361_pp_m164_candidate_share } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m169_cross_team_share_consumed value = var:zg361_pp_m164_candidate_share } }
					if = { limit = { has_variable = zg361_pp_m165_authority_bound } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m169_trial_authority_consumed value = var:zg361_pp_m165_authority_bound } }
					if = { limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m169_expert_weight value = 80 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m169_external_weight value = 20 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m169_familiarity_risk value = 1 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m169_weight_check value = var:zg361_pp_m169_expert_weight }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m169_weight_check add = var:zg361_pp_m169_external_weight }

				}

				zg361_pp_m169_consume_effect = yes
				zg361_pp_m169_schedule_audit_1_effect = yes
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

		limit = {

		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m169_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m169_consumer_value value = var:zg361_pp_m169_expertise_mix } }

		zg361_pp_v_try_advance_01_effect = yes
	}

					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial

					AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_available
					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_reserved
