zg361_pp_m170_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_v_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_v_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_pp_m170_receipt_owner
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = var:zg361_pp_m170_receipt_subject
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_pp_m170_receipt_cycle
				EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_pp_m170_receipt_case
				EXPECTED_STATE = var:zg361_pp_m170_receipt_state
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m170_receipt_active = 1
			var:zg361_pp_m170_consumed = 0
			has_variable = zg361_pp_m170_route
			always = yes
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m170_route = 3 } }
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m170_panel_selection
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m170_consumed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m170_consumer_revision value = var:zg361_case_v_revision }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m170_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m170_consumer_value value = var:zg361_pp_m170_panel_selection } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_completed add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_resource_partition value = var:zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_resource_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_v_resource_partition = var:zg361_pp_v_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_resource_conserved value = 1 } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_partition value = var:zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_partition add = var:zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_partition add = var:zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_partition = var:zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_conserved value = 1 } }
		zg361_pp_v_try_advance_01_effect = yes
	}
}

zg361_pp_m170_schedule_audit_1_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m170_audit_1_state = 0 var:zg361_pp_m170_receipt_active = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m170_audit_1_owner value = var:zg361_case_v_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m170_audit_1_subject value = this }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m170_audit_1_cycle value = var:zg361_case_v_cycle_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m170_audit_1_case value = var:zg361_case_v_case_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m170_audit_1_expected_state value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m170_audit_1_state value = 1 }
		if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m170_route = 3 }
		trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.2170 days = 180 }
	}
	else = { trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.2170 days = 30 } }
	}
}

zg361_pp_m171_manager_apply_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	if = {
		limit = {
			root = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
			zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
			liege = root
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_v_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_v_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
		}
		zg361_pp_m171_core_effect = {
			ROUTE = $ROUTE$
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
		}
	}
}

# 171 答辩评委利益回避: typed A/B/C write -> 投票器只接受回避后的活跃评委集合.
zg361_pp_m171_core_effect = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_cost_owner value = var:zg361_case_v_owner }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 }
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_v_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_v_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m171_receipt_active = 0
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				var:zg361_pp_m170_selection_replay_ok = 1
				var:zg361_pp_m170_panel_unique = 1
				has_variable = zg361_pp_v_panel_pool_4
				NOT = { var:zg361_pp_v_panel_pool_4 = var:zg361_pp_m170_panelist_1 }
				NOT = { var:zg361_pp_v_panel_pool_4 = var:zg361_pp_m170_panelist_2 }
				NOT = { var:zg361_pp_v_panel_pool_4 = var:zg361_pp_m170_panelist_3 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				var:zg361_pp_m170_selection_replay_ok = 1
				var:zg361_pp_m170_panel_unique = 1
			}
			else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				var:zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_available >= 1
				var:zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_available >= 1
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			always = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
			zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
			OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
			CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
			CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial
			STATE_VAR = zg361_case_v_state
			ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_v_active
			REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_v_revision
			TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_v_timeline_serial
			FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_v_feedback_revision
			LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_v_last_operation
			LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_v_last_choice
			RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m171_receipt_owner
			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_pp_m171_receipt_subject
			RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m171_receipt_cycle
			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m171_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_pp_m171_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_pp_m171_receipt_route
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			CHOICE = scope:zg361_pp_route
			OPERATION_ID = 171
			}
		}
		else = {
			# Route C is a policy-debt receipt, not a disguised business mutation.  It
			# deliberately does not call record_operation and therefore cannot change
			# the case revision, last operation, resource ledger, or typed payload.
			set_variable = { name = zg361_case_kernel_applied value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m171_receipt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m171_receipt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m171_receipt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m171_receipt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m171_receipt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m171_receipt_route value = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial
					STATE_VAR = zg361_case_v_state
					ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_v_active
					REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_v_revision
					AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_available
					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_reserved
					RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m171_operation_capacity_amount
					RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m171_operation_capacity_status
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m171_operation_capacity_owner
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m171_operation_capacity_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m171_operation_capacity_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
						CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_v_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_v_active
						REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_v_revision
						RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_reserved
						SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_settled
						RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m171_operation_capacity_amount
						RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m171_operation_capacity_status
						TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					}
				}
				zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial
					STATE_VAR = zg361_case_v_state
					ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_v_active
					REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_v_revision
					AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_available
					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_reserved
					RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m171_capacity_hours_amount
					RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m171_capacity_hours_status
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m171_capacity_hours_owner
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m171_capacity_hours_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m171_capacity_hours_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
						CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_v_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_v_active
						REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_v_revision
						RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_reserved
						SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_settled
						RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m171_capacity_hours_amount
						RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m171_capacity_hours_status
						TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }

				}
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }

				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
						var:zg361_pp_m171_operation_capacity_status = 1
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_pp_m171_operation_capacity_status = 2
					}
					else = { always = yes }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
						var:zg361_pp_m171_capacity_hours_status = 1
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_pp_m171_capacity_hours_status = 2
					}
					else = { always = yes }
					always = yes
					always = yes
				}
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m171_receipt_active value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m171_route value = scope:zg361_pp_route }
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m171_panel_recusal value = 1 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_evidence_led add = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m171_panel_recusal value = 2 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_political add = 1 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m171_deferred value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m171_policy_debt_due_days value = 90 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_policy_debt add = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m171_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_v_owner }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m171_object_subject value = this }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m171_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_v_cycle_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m171_object_case value = var:zg361_case_v_case_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m171_object_state value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m171_conflicts_disclosed value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m171_recused_panelist value = var:zg361_pp_m170_panelist_1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m171_replacement_panelist value = var:zg361_pp_v_panel_pool_4 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m171_active_panel_1 value = var:zg361_pp_v_panel_pool_4 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m171_active_panel_2 value = var:zg361_pp_m170_panelist_2 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m171_active_panel_3 value = var:zg361_pp_m170_panelist_3 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m171_active_panel_count value = 3 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m171_active_panel_revision value = { value = var:zg361_case_v_revision add = 1 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m171_replacement_same_kind value = 1 }
					if = { limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m171_conflicts_disclosed value = 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m171_active_panel_1 value = var:zg361_pp_m170_panelist_1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m171_rereview_debt value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m171_active_panel_revision value = { value = var:zg361_pp_m171_active_panel_revision add = 1 } } }

				}

				zg361_pp_m171_consume_effect = yes
				zg361_pp_m171_schedule_audit_1_effect = yes
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

zg361_pp_m171_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_v_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_v_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_pp_m171_receipt_owner
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = var:zg361_pp_m171_receipt_subject
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_pp_m171_receipt_cycle
				EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_pp_m171_receipt_case
				EXPECTED_STATE = var:zg361_pp_m171_receipt_state
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m171_receipt_active = 1
			var:zg361_pp_m171_consumed = 0
			has_variable = zg361_pp_m171_route
			always = yes
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m171_route = 3 } }
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m171_panel_recusal
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m171_consumed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m171_consumer_revision value = var:zg361_case_v_revision }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m171_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m171_consumer_value value = var:zg361_pp_m171_panel_recusal } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_completed add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_resource_partition value = var:zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_resource_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_v_resource_partition = var:zg361_pp_v_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_resource_conserved value = 1 } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_partition value = var:zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_partition add = var:zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_partition add = var:zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_partition = var:zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_conserved value = 1 } }
		zg361_pp_v_try_advance_01_effect = yes
	}
}

zg361_pp_m171_schedule_audit_1_effect = {

		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m171_audit_1_state = 0 var:zg361_pp_m171_receipt_active = 1 }

	}
}

			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
		}
	}

# 172 一票否决 / 多数票 / 平均分: typed A/B/C write -> 最终决定只消费冻结规则下的一人一票.
zg361_pp_m172_core_effect = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_cost_owner value = var:zg361_case_v_owner }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 }
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject

				has_variable = zg361_pp_m171_active_panel_revision
			}
			else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				var:zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_available >= 1
				var:zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_available >= 1
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }

		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }

			LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_v_last_choice
			RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m172_receipt_owner
			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_pp_m172_receipt_subject
			RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m172_receipt_cycle
			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m172_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_pp_m172_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_pp_m172_receipt_route
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			CHOICE = scope:zg361_pp_route
			OPERATION_ID = 172
			}
		}
		else = {
			# Route C is a policy-debt receipt, not a disguised business mutation.  It
			# deliberately does not call record_operation and therefore cannot change
			# the case revision, last operation, resource ledger, or typed payload.
			set_variable = { name = zg361_case_kernel_applied value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m172_receipt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m172_receipt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m172_receipt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m172_receipt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m172_receipt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m172_receipt_route value = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }

				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial

					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$

					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {

					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m173_blind_live_review value = 1 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_evidence_led add = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m173_blind_live_review value = 2 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_political add = 1 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m173_deferred value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m173_policy_debt_due_days value = 180 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_policy_debt add = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m173_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_v_owner }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m173_object_subject value = this }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m173_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_v_cycle_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m173_object_case value = var:zg361_case_v_case_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m173_object_state value = 2 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m173_blind_score value = 78 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m173_blind_score_frozen value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m173_identity_fields_hidden value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m173_live_score value = 72 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m173_unblind_after_freeze value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m173_active_panel_revision_consumed value = var:zg361_pp_m172_active_panel_revision_consumed }
					if = { limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m173_blind_score value = 55 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m173_live_score value = 90 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m173_identity_fields_hidden value = 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m173_relationship_anchor value = 1 } }

				}

				zg361_pp_m173_consume_effect = yes
				zg361_pp_m173_schedule_audit_1_effect = yes
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}

zg361_pp_m173_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_v_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_v_active

				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = var:zg361_pp_m173_receipt_subject

				EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_pp_m173_receipt_case
				EXPECTED_STATE = var:zg361_pp_m173_receipt_state
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m173_receipt_active = 1
			var:zg361_pp_m173_consumed = 0
			has_variable = zg361_pp_m173_route
			always = yes
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m173_route = 3 } }
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m173_blind_live_review
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m173_consumed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m173_consumer_revision value = var:zg361_case_v_revision }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m173_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m173_consumer_value value = var:zg361_pp_m173_blind_live_review } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_completed add = 1 }

		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_resource_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_v_resource_partition = var:zg361_pp_v_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_resource_conserved value = 1 } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_partition value = var:zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_partition add = var:zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_partition add = var:zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_partition = var:zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_conserved value = 1 } }
		zg361_pp_v_try_advance_02_effect = yes
	}
}

	}
}

				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_v_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_v_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
		}
		zg361_pp_m174_core_effect = {
			ROUTE = $ROUTE$

			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
		}
	}
}

# 174 答辩时间预算: typed A/B/C write -> 答辩记录校验陈述加质询等于冻结总时长.

	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_cost_owner value = var:zg361_case_v_owner }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 }
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject

				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m174_receipt_active = 0
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }

				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }

				var:zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_available >= 1
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }

				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }

		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }

			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject

			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			CHOICE = scope:zg361_pp_route
			OPERATION_ID = 174
			}
		}
		else = {
			# Route C is a policy-debt receipt, not a disguised business mutation.  It
			# deliberately does not call record_operation and therefore cannot change
			# the case revision, last operation, resource ledger, or typed payload.
			set_variable = { name = zg361_case_kernel_applied value = 1 }

			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m174_receipt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m174_receipt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m174_receipt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m174_receipt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m174_receipt_route value = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }

				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial

					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_reserved
					RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m174_operation_capacity_amount
					RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m174_operation_capacity_status
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m174_operation_capacity_owner
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m174_operation_capacity_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m174_operation_capacity_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {

				zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial
					STATE_VAR = zg361_case_v_state
					ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_v_active
					REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_v_revision
					AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_available
					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_reserved
					RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m174_panel_vote_amount
					RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m174_panel_vote_status
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m174_panel_vote_owner
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m174_panel_vote_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m174_panel_vote_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$

					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
						CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_v_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_v_active
						REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_v_revision

		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_partition add = var:zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_partition = var:zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_conserved value = 1 } }
		zg361_pp_v_try_advance_03_effect = yes
	}
}

# 175 模拟答辩与辅导资源: typed A/B/C write -> 辅导账校验已分配工时不超过开放池.
zg361_pp_m175_core_effect = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_cost_owner value = var:zg361_case_v_owner }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 }
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_v_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_v_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m175_receipt_active = 0
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				var:zg361_pp_m174_time_check = 60
				var:zg361_pp_m174_question_minutes >= 5
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				var:zg361_pp_m174_time_check = 60
				var:zg361_pp_m174_question_minutes >= 5
			}
			else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				var:zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_available >= 1
				var:zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_available >= 1
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			always = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
			zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
			OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
			CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
			CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial
			STATE_VAR = zg361_case_v_state
			ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_v_active
			REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_v_revision
			TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_v_timeline_serial
			FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_v_feedback_revision
			LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_v_last_operation
			LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_v_last_choice
			RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m175_receipt_owner
			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_pp_m175_receipt_subject
			RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m175_receipt_cycle
			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m175_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_pp_m175_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_pp_m175_receipt_route
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			CHOICE = scope:zg361_pp_route
			OPERATION_ID = 175
			}
		}
		else = {
			# Route C is a policy-debt receipt, not a disguised business mutation.  It
			# deliberately does not call record_operation and therefore cannot change
			# the case revision, last operation, resource ledger, or typed payload.
			set_variable = { name = zg361_case_kernel_applied value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m175_receipt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m175_receipt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m175_receipt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m175_receipt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m175_receipt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m175_receipt_route value = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial
					STATE_VAR = zg361_case_v_state
					ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_v_active
					REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_v_revision
					AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_available
					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_reserved
					RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m175_operation_capacity_amount
					RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m175_operation_capacity_status
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m175_operation_capacity_owner
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m175_operation_capacity_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m175_operation_capacity_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
						CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_v_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_v_active
						REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_v_revision
						RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_reserved
						SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_settled
						RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m175_operation_capacity_amount
						RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m175_operation_capacity_status
						TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					}
				}
				zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial
					STATE_VAR = zg361_case_v_state
					ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_v_active
					REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_v_revision
					AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_available
					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_reserved
					RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m175_capacity_hours_amount
					RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m175_capacity_hours_status
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m175_capacity_hours_owner
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m175_capacity_hours_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m175_capacity_hours_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
						CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_v_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_v_active
						REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_v_revision
						RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_reserved
						SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_settled
						RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m175_capacity_hours_amount
						RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m175_capacity_hours_status
						TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }

				}
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }

				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
						var:zg361_pp_m175_operation_capacity_status = 1
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_pp_m175_operation_capacity_status = 2
					}
					else = { always = yes }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
						var:zg361_pp_m175_capacity_hours_status = 1
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_pp_m175_capacity_hours_status = 2
					}
					else = { always = yes }
					always = yes
					always = yes
				}
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m175_receipt_active value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m175_route value = scope:zg361_pp_route }
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m175_coaching_pool value = 1 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_evidence_led add = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m175_coaching_pool value = 2 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_political add = 1 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m175_deferred value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m175_policy_debt_due_days value = 90 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_policy_debt add = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m175_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_v_owner }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m175_object_subject value = this }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m175_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_v_cycle_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m175_object_case value = var:zg361_case_v_case_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m175_object_state value = 3 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m175_coaching_opening value = 10 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m175_coaching_allocated value = 10 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m175_coaching_remaining value = var:zg361_pp_m175_coaching_opening }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m175_coaching_remaining add = { value = var:zg361_pp_m175_coaching_allocated multiply = -1 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m175_coaching_conserved value = 0 }
					if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_m175_coaching_remaining >= 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m175_coaching_conserved value = 1 } }
					if = { limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m175_opportunity_inequality value = 1 } }

				}

				zg361_pp_m175_consume_effect = yes
				zg361_pp_m175_schedule_audit_1_effect = yes
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

zg361_pp_m175_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_v_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_v_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_pp_m175_receipt_owner
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = var:zg361_pp_m175_receipt_subject
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_pp_m175_receipt_cycle
				EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_pp_m175_receipt_case
				EXPECTED_STATE = var:zg361_pp_m175_receipt_state
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m175_receipt_active = 1
			var:zg361_pp_m175_consumed = 0
			has_variable = zg361_pp_m175_route
			always = yes
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m175_route = 3 } }
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m175_coaching_pool
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m175_consumed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m175_consumer_revision value = var:zg361_case_v_revision }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m175_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m175_consumer_value value = var:zg361_pp_m175_coaching_pool } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_completed add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_resource_partition value = var:zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_resource_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_v_resource_partition = var:zg361_pp_v_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_resource_conserved value = 1 } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_partition value = var:zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_partition add = var:zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_partition add = var:zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_partition = var:zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_conserved value = 1 } }
		zg361_pp_v_try_advance_03_effect = yes
	}
}

# 176 团队成绩的个人归因质询: typed A/B/C write -> 评委只按冻结个人份额计算影响证据.
zg361_pp_m176_core_effect = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_cost_owner value = var:zg361_case_v_owner }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 }
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_v_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_v_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m176_receipt_active = 0
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				var:zg361_pp_m174_time_check = 60
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m175_coaching_allocated
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				var:zg361_pp_m174_time_check = 60
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m175_coaching_allocated
			}
			else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				var:zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_available >= 1
				var:zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_available >= 1
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			always = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
			zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
			OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
			CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
			CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial
			STATE_VAR = zg361_case_v_state
			ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_v_active
			REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_v_revision
			TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_v_timeline_serial
			FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_v_feedback_revision
			LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_v_last_operation
			LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_v_last_choice
			RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m176_receipt_owner
			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_pp_m176_receipt_subject
			RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m176_receipt_cycle
			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m176_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_pp_m176_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_pp_m176_receipt_route
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			CHOICE = scope:zg361_pp_route
			OPERATION_ID = 176
			}
		}
		else = {
			# Route C is a policy-debt receipt, not a disguised business mutation.  It
			# deliberately does not call record_operation and therefore cannot change
			# the case revision, last operation, resource ledger, or typed payload.
			set_variable = { name = zg361_case_kernel_applied value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m176_receipt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m176_receipt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m176_receipt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m176_receipt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m176_receipt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m176_receipt_route value = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial
					STATE_VAR = zg361_case_v_state
					ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_v_active
					REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_v_revision
					AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_available
					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_reserved
					RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m176_operation_capacity_amount
					RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m176_operation_capacity_status
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m176_operation_capacity_owner
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m176_operation_capacity_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m176_operation_capacity_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
						CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_v_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_v_active
						REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_v_revision
						RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_reserved
						SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_settled
						RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m176_operation_capacity_amount
						RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m176_operation_capacity_status
						TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					}
				}
				zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial
					STATE_VAR = zg361_case_v_state
					ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_v_active
					REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_v_revision
					AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_available
					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_reserved
					RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m176_panel_vote_amount
					RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m176_panel_vote_status
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m176_panel_vote_owner
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m176_panel_vote_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m176_panel_vote_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
						CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_v_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_v_active
						REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_v_revision
						RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_reserved
						SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_settled
						RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m176_panel_vote_amount
						RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m176_panel_vote_status
						TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }

				}
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }

				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
						var:zg361_pp_m176_operation_capacity_status = 1
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_pp_m176_operation_capacity_status = 2
					}
					else = { always = yes }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
						var:zg361_pp_m176_panel_vote_status = 1
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_pp_m176_panel_vote_status = 2
					}
					else = { always = yes }
					always = yes
					always = yes
				}
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m176_receipt_active value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m176_route value = scope:zg361_pp_route }
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m176_individual_attribution value = 1 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_evidence_led add = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m176_individual_attribution value = 2 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_political add = 1 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m176_deferred value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m176_policy_debt_due_days value = 90 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_policy_debt add = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m176_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_v_owner }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m176_object_subject value = this }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m176_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_v_cycle_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m176_object_case value = var:zg361_case_v_case_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m176_object_state value = 3 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m176_candidate_share value = 40 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m176_peer_share value = 60 }
					if = { limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m176_candidate_share value = 100 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m176_peer_share value = 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m176_credit_grab_debt value = 1 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m176_share_check value = var:zg361_pp_m176_candidate_share }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m176_share_check add = var:zg361_pp_m176_peer_share }

				}

				zg361_pp_m176_consume_effect = yes
				zg361_pp_m176_schedule_audit_1_effect = yes
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

zg361_pp_m176_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_v_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_v_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_pp_m176_receipt_owner
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = var:zg361_pp_m176_receipt_subject
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_pp_m176_receipt_cycle
				EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_pp_m176_receipt_case
				EXPECTED_STATE = var:zg361_pp_m176_receipt_state
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m176_receipt_active = 1
			var:zg361_pp_m176_consumed = 0
			has_variable = zg361_pp_m176_route
			always = yes
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m176_route = 3 } }
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m176_individual_attribution
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m176_consumed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m176_consumer_revision value = var:zg361_case_v_revision }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m176_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m176_consumer_value value = var:zg361_pp_m176_individual_attribution } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_completed add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_resource_partition value = var:zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_resource_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_v_resource_partition = var:zg361_pp_v_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_resource_conserved value = 1 } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_partition value = var:zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_partition add = var:zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_partition add = var:zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_partition = var:zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_conserved value = 1 } }
		zg361_pp_v_try_advance_03_effect = yes
	}
}

zg361_pp_m176_schedule_audit_1_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m176_audit_1_state = 0 var:zg361_pp_m176_receipt_active = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m176_audit_1_owner value = var:zg361_case_v_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m176_audit_1_subject value = this }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m176_audit_1_cycle value = var:zg361_case_v_cycle_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m176_audit_1_case value = var:zg361_case_v_case_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m176_audit_1_expected_state value = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m176_audit_1_state value = 1 }
		if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m176_route = 3 }
		trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.2176 days = 90 }
	}
	else = { trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.2176 days = 30 } }
	}
}

	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	if = {

				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
		}
		zg361_pp_m177_core_effect = {
			ROUTE = $ROUTE$
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$

			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
		}
	}
}

# 177 项目规模与个人杠杆分离: typed A/B/C write -> 目标职级判定同时消费两个独立维度.
zg361_pp_m177_core_effect = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_cost_owner value = var:zg361_case_v_owner }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 }

			}

			}
			else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				var:zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_available >= 1
				var:zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_available >= 1
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }

		}
		if = {

			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_pp_m177_receipt_subject

			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m177_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_pp_m177_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_pp_m177_receipt_route
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			CHOICE = scope:zg361_pp_route
			OPERATION_ID = 177
			}
		}

			# deliberately does not call record_operation and therefore cannot change
			# the case revision, last operation, resource ledger, or typed payload.

			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m177_receipt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m177_receipt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m177_receipt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }

					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial

				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);

zg361_pp_m177_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_v_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_v_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_pp_m177_receipt_owner
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = var:zg361_pp_m177_receipt_subject
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_pp_m177_receipt_cycle
				EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_pp_m177_receipt_case
				EXPECTED_STATE = var:zg361_pp_m177_receipt_state
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m177_receipt_active = 1
			var:zg361_pp_m177_consumed = 0
			has_variable = zg361_pp_m177_route
			always = yes
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m177_route = 3 } }
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m177_scale_leverage
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m177_consumed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m177_consumer_revision value = var:zg361_case_v_revision }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m177_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m177_consumer_value value = var:zg361_pp_m177_scale_leverage } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_completed add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_resource_partition value = var:zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_resource_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_v_resource_partition = var:zg361_pp_v_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_resource_conserved value = 1 } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_partition value = var:zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_partition add = var:zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_partition add = var:zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_partition = var:zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_conserved value = 1 } }
		zg361_pp_v_try_advance_04_effect = yes
	}
}

			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m179_consumed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m179_consumer_revision value = var:zg361_case_v_revision }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m179_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m179_consumer_value value = var:zg361_pp_m179_rejection_feedback } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_completed add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_resource_partition value = var:zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_resource_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_v_resource_partition = var:zg361_pp_v_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_resource_conserved value = 1 } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_partition value = var:zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_partition add = var:zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_partition add = var:zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_partition = var:zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_conserved value = 1 } }
		zg361_pp_v_try_advance_05_effect = yes
	}
}

				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial

				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
		}

			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
		}
	}

# 180 晋升冷却与材料刷新: typed A/B/C write -> 重试只复用版本化旧材料并追加新影响.
zg361_pp_m180_core_effect = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_cost_owner value = var:zg361_case_v_owner }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 }
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_v_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_v_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m180_receipt_active = 0
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				var:zg361_pp_m178_final_decision = 0
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m179_gap_id
				var:zg361_pp_m179_feedback_owner = var:zg361_pp_m171_active_panel_1
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				var:zg361_pp_m178_final_decision = 0
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m179_gap_id
				var:zg361_pp_m179_feedback_owner = var:zg361_pp_m171_active_panel_1
			}
			else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				var:zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_available >= 1
				var:zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_available >= 1
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			always = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
			zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
			OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
			CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
			CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial
			STATE_VAR = zg361_case_v_state
			ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_v_active
			REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_v_revision
			TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_v_timeline_serial
			FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_v_feedback_revision
			LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_v_last_operation
			LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_v_last_choice
			RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m180_receipt_owner
			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_pp_m180_receipt_subject
			RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m180_receipt_cycle
			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m180_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_pp_m180_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_pp_m180_receipt_route
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			CHOICE = scope:zg361_pp_route
			OPERATION_ID = 180
			}
		}
		else = {
			# Route C is a policy-debt receipt, not a disguised business mutation.  It
			# deliberately does not call record_operation and therefore cannot change
			# the case revision, last operation, resource ledger, or typed payload.
			set_variable = { name = zg361_case_kernel_applied value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m180_receipt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m180_receipt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m180_receipt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m180_receipt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m180_receipt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m180_receipt_route value = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial
					STATE_VAR = zg361_case_v_state
					ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_v_active
					REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_v_revision
					AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_available
					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_reserved
					RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m180_operation_capacity_amount
					RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m180_operation_capacity_status
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m180_operation_capacity_owner
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m180_operation_capacity_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m180_operation_capacity_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
						CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_v_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_v_active
						REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_v_revision
						RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_reserved
						SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_settled
						RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m180_operation_capacity_amount
						RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m180_operation_capacity_status
						TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					}
				}
				zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial
					STATE_VAR = zg361_case_v_state
					ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_v_active
					REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_v_revision
					AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_available
					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_reserved
					RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m180_panel_vote_amount
					RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m180_panel_vote_status
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m180_panel_vote_owner
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m180_panel_vote_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m180_panel_vote_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
						CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_v_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_v_active
						REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_v_revision
						RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_reserved
						SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_settled
						RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m180_panel_vote_amount
						RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m180_panel_vote_status
						TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }

				}
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }

				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
						var:zg361_pp_m180_operation_capacity_status = 1
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_pp_m180_operation_capacity_status = 2
					}
					else = { always = yes }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
						var:zg361_pp_m180_panel_vote_status = 1
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_pp_m180_panel_vote_status = 2
					}
					else = { always = yes }
					always = yes
					always = yes
				}
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m180_receipt_active value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m180_route value = scope:zg361_pp_route }

				}

					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m180_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_v_owner }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m180_object_subject value = this }

					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m180_object_case value = var:zg361_case_v_case_serial }

					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m180_candidate value = this }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m180_cooldown_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_v_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m180_prior_gap_id value = var:zg361_pp_m179_gap_id }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m180_prior_material_version value = var:zg361_case_v_revision }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m180_new_material_version value = { value = var:zg361_case_v_revision add = 1 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m180_gap_completion value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m180_retry_count value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m180_retry_available value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m180_nomination_slot_consumed value = 0 }

				zg361_pp_m180_schedule_audit_1_effect = yes
			zg361_pp_m180_schedule_audit_2_effect = yes

			}
		}
	}

			}

		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m180_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m180_consumer_value value = var:zg361_pp_m180_retry_cooldown } }

		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_partition add = var:zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_partition add = var:zg361_pp_v_panel_vote_settled }

	}
