zg361_pp_m181_manager_apply_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	if = {
		limit = {
			root = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
			zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
			liege = root
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
		}
		zg361_pp_m181_core_effect = {
			ROUTE = $ROUTE$
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
		}
	}
}

# 181 能力、意愿、错岗三分诊: typed A/B/C write -> PIP 入口按唯一主类别选择训练、纪律或转岗.
zg361_pp_m181_core_effect = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_cost_owner value = var:zg361_case_w_owner }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 }
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m181_receipt_active = 0
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				always = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				always = yes
			}
			else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				var:zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_available >= 1
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			always = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
			zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
			OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
			CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
			CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
			STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
			ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
			REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_w_revision
			TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_w_timeline_serial
			FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_w_feedback_revision
			LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_w_last_operation
			LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_w_last_choice
			RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m181_receipt_owner
			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_pp_m181_receipt_subject
			RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m181_receipt_cycle
			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m181_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_pp_m181_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_pp_m181_receipt_route
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			CHOICE = scope:zg361_pp_route
			OPERATION_ID = 181
			}
		}
		else = {
			# Route C is a policy-debt receipt, not a disguised business mutation.  It
			# deliberately does not call record_operation and therefore cannot change
			# the case revision, last operation, resource ledger, or typed payload.
			set_variable = { name = zg361_case_kernel_applied value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m181_receipt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m181_receipt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m181_receipt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m181_receipt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m181_receipt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m181_receipt_route value = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
					STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
					ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
					REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_w_revision
					AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_available
					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_reserved
					RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m181_operation_capacity_amount
					RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m181_operation_capacity_status
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m181_operation_capacity_owner
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m181_operation_capacity_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m181_operation_capacity_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
						CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
						REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_w_revision
						RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_reserved
						SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_settled
						RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m181_operation_capacity_amount
						RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m181_operation_capacity_status
						TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }

				}
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }

				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
						var:zg361_pp_m181_operation_capacity_status = 1
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_pp_m181_operation_capacity_status = 2
					}
					else = { always = yes }
					always = yes
					always = yes
				}
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m181_receipt_active value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m181_route value = scope:zg361_pp_route }
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m181_triage_category value = 1 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_evidence_led add = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m181_triage_category value = 2 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_political add = 1 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m181_deferred value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m181_policy_debt_due_days value = 90 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_policy_debt add = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m181_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_w_owner }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m181_object_subject value = this }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m181_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_w_cycle_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m181_object_case value = var:zg361_case_w_case_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m181_object_state value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m181_evidence_id value = { value = var:zg361_case_w_case_serial multiply = 1000 add = 181 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m181_result_owner_snapshot value = var:zg361_pp_w_result_owner }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m181_result_cycle_snapshot value = var:zg361_pp_w_result_cycle }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m181_result_case_snapshot value = var:zg361_pp_w_result_case }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m181_result_state_snapshot value = var:zg361_pp_w_result_state }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m181_result_grade_snapshot value = var:zg361_pp_w_frozen_grade }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m181_result_reason_snapshot value = var:zg361_pp_w_frozen_reason }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m181_evidence_component_count value = var:zg361_pp_w_evidence_component_count }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m181_primary_category value = 1 }
					if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_w_frozen_reason = 5 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m181_primary_category value = 3 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m181_current_rating_unchanged value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m181_misdiagnosis_risk value = 0 }
					if = { limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m181_primary_category value = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m181_misdiagnosis_risk value = 1 } }

				}

				zg361_pp_m181_consume_effect = yes
				zg361_pp_m181_schedule_audit_1_effect = yes
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

zg361_pp_m181_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_pp_m181_receipt_owner
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = var:zg361_pp_m181_receipt_subject
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_pp_m181_receipt_cycle
				EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_pp_m181_receipt_case
				EXPECTED_STATE = var:zg361_pp_m181_receipt_state
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m181_receipt_active = 1
			var:zg361_pp_m181_consumed = 0
			has_variable = zg361_pp_m181_route
			always = yes
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m181_route = 3 } }
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m181_triage_category
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m181_consumed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m181_consumer_revision value = var:zg361_case_w_revision }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m181_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m181_consumer_value value = var:zg361_pp_m181_triage_category } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_completed add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_partition value = var:zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_w_resource_partition = var:zg361_pp_w_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_conserved value = 1 } }

		zg361_pp_w_try_advance_01_effect = yes
	}
}

zg361_pp_m181_schedule_audit_1_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m181_audit_1_state = 0 var:zg361_pp_m181_receipt_active = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m181_audit_1_owner value = var:zg361_case_w_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m181_audit_1_subject value = this }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m181_audit_1_cycle value = var:zg361_case_w_cycle_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m181_audit_1_case value = var:zg361_case_w_case_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m181_audit_1_expected_state value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m181_audit_1_state value = 1 }
		if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m181_route = 3 }
		trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.2181 days = 90 }
	}
	else = { trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.2181 days = 30 } }
	}
}

zg361_pp_m182_manager_apply_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	if = {
		limit = {
			root = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
			zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
			liege = root
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
		}
		zg361_pp_m182_core_effect = {
			ROUTE = $ROUTE$
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
		}
	}
}

# 182 PIP 启动证据门槛: typed A/B/C write -> 启动门把红线违纪分流到独立纪律案.
zg361_pp_m182_core_effect = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_cost_owner value = var:zg361_case_w_owner }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 }
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m182_receipt_active = 0
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m181_primary_category
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m181_evidence_id
				var:zg361_pp_m181_result_grade_snapshot = var:zg361_pp_w_frozen_grade
				var:zg361_pp_w_pip_gate_candidate = 1
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m181_primary_category
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m181_evidence_id
				var:zg361_pp_m181_result_grade_snapshot = var:zg361_pp_w_frozen_grade
				var:zg361_pp_w_frozen_grade = 1
			}
			else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				var:zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_available >= 1
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			always = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
			zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
			OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
			CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
			CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
			STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
			ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
			REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_w_revision
			TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_w_timeline_serial
			FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_w_feedback_revision
			LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_w_last_operation
			LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_w_last_choice
			RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m182_receipt_owner
			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_pp_m182_receipt_subject
			RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m182_receipt_cycle
			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m182_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_pp_m182_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_pp_m182_receipt_route
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			CHOICE = scope:zg361_pp_route
			OPERATION_ID = 182
			}
		}
		else = {
			# Route C is a policy-debt receipt, not a disguised business mutation.  It
			# deliberately does not call record_operation and therefore cannot change
			# the case revision, last operation, resource ledger, or typed payload.
			set_variable = { name = zg361_case_kernel_applied value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m182_receipt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m182_receipt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m182_receipt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m182_receipt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m182_receipt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m182_receipt_route value = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
					STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
					ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
					REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_w_revision
					AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_available
					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_reserved
					RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m182_operation_capacity_amount
					RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m182_operation_capacity_status
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m182_operation_capacity_owner
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m182_operation_capacity_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m182_operation_capacity_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
						CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
						REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_w_revision
						RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_reserved
						SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_settled
						RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m182_operation_capacity_amount
						RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m182_operation_capacity_status
						TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }

				}
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }

				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
						var:zg361_pp_m182_operation_capacity_status = 1
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_pp_m182_operation_capacity_status = 2
					}
					else = { always = yes }
					always = yes
					always = yes
				}
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m182_receipt_active value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m182_route value = scope:zg361_pp_route }
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m182_pip_evidence_gate value = 1 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_evidence_led add = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m182_pip_evidence_gate value = 2 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_political add = 1 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m182_deferred value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m182_policy_debt_due_days value = 90 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_policy_debt add = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m182_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_w_owner }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m182_object_subject value = this }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m182_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_w_cycle_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m182_object_case value = var:zg361_case_w_case_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m182_object_state value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m182_evidence_bundle_id value = var:zg361_pp_m181_evidence_id }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m182_evidence_component_count value = var:zg361_pp_m181_evidence_component_count }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m182_threshold_required value = 3 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m182_evidence_threshold_met value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m182_grade_only_autostart value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m182_gate_status value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m182_misconduct_routed_separately value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m182_false_positive_risk value = 0 }
					if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 var:zg361_pp_w_pip_gate_candidate = 1 }
						set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m182_evidence_threshold_met value = 1 }
						set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m182_gate_status value = 1 }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 var:zg361_pp_w_frozen_grade = 1 }
						set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m182_grade_only_autostart value = 1 }
						set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m182_gate_status value = 2 }
						set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m182_false_positive_risk value = 1 }
					}

				}

				zg361_pp_m182_consume_effect = yes
				zg361_pp_m182_schedule_audit_1_effect = yes
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

zg361_pp_m182_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_pp_m182_receipt_owner
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = var:zg361_pp_m182_receipt_subject
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_pp_m182_receipt_cycle
				EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_pp_m182_receipt_case
				EXPECTED_STATE = var:zg361_pp_m182_receipt_state
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m182_receipt_active = 1
			var:zg361_pp_m182_consumed = 0
			has_variable = zg361_pp_m182_route
			always = yes
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m182_route = 3 } }
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m182_pip_evidence_gate
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m182_consumed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m182_consumer_revision value = var:zg361_case_w_revision }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m182_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m182_consumer_value value = var:zg361_pp_m182_pip_evidence_gate } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_completed add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_partition value = var:zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_w_resource_partition = var:zg361_pp_w_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_conserved value = 1 } }

		zg361_pp_w_try_advance_01_effect = yes
	}
}

zg361_pp_m182_schedule_audit_1_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m182_audit_1_state = 0 var:zg361_pp_m182_receipt_active = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m182_audit_1_owner value = var:zg361_case_w_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m182_audit_1_subject value = this }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m182_audit_1_cycle value = var:zg361_case_w_cycle_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m182_audit_1_case value = var:zg361_case_w_case_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m182_audit_1_expected_state value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m182_audit_1_state value = 1 }
		if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m182_route = 3 }
		trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.2182 days = 90 }
	}
	else = { trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.2182 days = 30 } }
	}
}

zg361_pp_m183_manager_apply_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	if = {
		limit = {
			root = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
			zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
			liege = root
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
		}
		zg361_pp_m183_core_effect = {
			ROUTE = $ROUTE$
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
		}
	}
}

# The assessed official may respond only to their own packet.  This grants no
# cohort, nomination, panel, PIP-initiation or assessment authority.
zg361_pp_m183_subject_response_effect = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_subject_route value = $ROUTE$ }
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_ai = no
			OR = { scope:zg361_pp_subject_route = 1 scope:zg361_pp_subject_route = 2 }
			zg361_case_kernel_subject_self_guard_trigger = {
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
			}
			var:zg361_case_w_state = 1
			NOT = { has_variable = zg361_pp_m183_subject_response }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_subject_response value = scope:zg361_pp_subject_route }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:zg361_pp_subject_route = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_subject_signed value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_acknowledgement_status value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_subject_statement_code value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_subject_statement_author value = this }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:zg361_pp_subject_route = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_subject_signed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_acknowledgement_status value = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_subject_statement_code value = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_subject_statement_author value = this }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_refusal_reason value = 1 }
		}
		change_variable = { name = zg361_case_w_feedback_revision add = 1 }
	}
}

# 183 PIP 目标双签与拒签理由: typed A/B/C write -> 任务页区分送达、认同、拒签和一次修订.
zg361_pp_m183_core_effect = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_cost_owner value = var:zg361_case_w_owner }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 }
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m183_receipt_active = 0
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m182_gate_status
				var:zg361_pp_m182_gate_status = 1
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m182_gate_status
				var:zg361_pp_m182_gate_status = 2
			}
			else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				var:zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_available >= 1
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			always = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
			zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
			OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
			CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
			CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
			STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
			ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
			REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_w_revision
			TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_w_timeline_serial
			FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_w_feedback_revision
			LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_w_last_operation
			LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_w_last_choice
			RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m183_receipt_owner
			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_pp_m183_receipt_subject
			RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m183_receipt_cycle
			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m183_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_pp_m183_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_pp_m183_receipt_route
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			CHOICE = scope:zg361_pp_route
			OPERATION_ID = 183
			}
		}
		else = {
			# Route C is a policy-debt receipt, not a disguised business mutation.  It
			# deliberately does not call record_operation and therefore cannot change
			# the case revision, last operation, resource ledger, or typed payload.
			set_variable = { name = zg361_case_kernel_applied value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_receipt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_receipt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_receipt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_receipt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_receipt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_receipt_route value = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
					STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
					ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
					REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_w_revision
					AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_available
					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_reserved
					RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m183_operation_capacity_amount
					RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m183_operation_capacity_status
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m183_operation_capacity_owner
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m183_operation_capacity_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m183_operation_capacity_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
						CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
						REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_w_revision
						RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_reserved
						SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_settled
						RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m183_operation_capacity_amount
						RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m183_operation_capacity_status
						TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }

				}
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }

				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
						var:zg361_pp_m183_operation_capacity_status = 1
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_pp_m183_operation_capacity_status = 2
					}
					else = { always = yes }
					always = yes
					always = yes
				}
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_receipt_active value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_route value = scope:zg361_pp_route }
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_pip_acknowledgement value = 1 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_evidence_led add = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_pip_acknowledgement value = 2 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_political add = 1 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_deferred value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_policy_debt_due_days value = 90 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_policy_debt add = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_w_owner }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_object_subject value = this }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_w_cycle_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_object_case value = var:zg361_case_w_case_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_object_state value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_goal_bundle_id value = { value = var:zg361_case_w_case_serial multiply = 1000 add = 183 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_goals_frozen value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_resources_frozen value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_deadline_days value = 180 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_manager_signed value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_subject_signed value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_independent_review_pass value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_acknowledgement_status value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_subject_statement_code value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_subject_statement_author value = this }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_revision_remaining value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_refusal_is_failure value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_non_aggravation_grade value = var:zg361_pp_w_non_aggravation_grade }
					if = { limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_subject_signed value = 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_independent_review_pass value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_acknowledgement_status value = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_subject_statement_code value = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_refusal_reason value = 1 } }

				}

				zg361_pp_m183_consume_effect = yes
				zg361_pp_m183_schedule_audit_1_effect = yes
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_pp_m183_receipt_owner
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = var:zg361_pp_m183_receipt_subject
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_pp_m183_receipt_cycle
				EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_pp_m183_receipt_case
				EXPECTED_STATE = var:zg361_pp_m183_receipt_state
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m183_receipt_active = 1
			var:zg361_pp_m183_consumed = 0
			has_variable = zg361_pp_m183_route
			always = yes
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m183_route = 3 } }
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m183_pip_acknowledgement
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_consumed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_consumer_revision value = var:zg361_case_w_revision }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m183_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m183_consumer_value value = var:zg361_pp_m183_pip_acknowledgement } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_completed add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_partition value = var:zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_w_resource_partition = var:zg361_pp_w_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_conserved value = 1 } }

		zg361_pp_w_try_advance_01_effect = yes
	}
}

	}

# 184 经理的 PIP 承载量: typed A/B/C write -> 容量面板按终态一次释放每案预留.
zg361_pp_m184_core_effect = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_cost_owner value = var:zg361_case_w_owner }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 }
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m184_receipt_active = 0
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				OR = {
					var:zg361_pp_m182_gate_status = 1
					var:zg361_pp_m182_gate_status = 2
				}
				var:zg361_pp_m183_goals_frozen = 1
				var:zg361_pp_m183_manager_signed = 1
				OR = {
					var:zg361_pp_m183_subject_signed = 1
					var:zg361_pp_m183_independent_review_pass = 1
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				OR = {
					var:zg361_pp_m182_gate_status = 1
					var:zg361_pp_m182_gate_status = 2
				}
				var:zg361_pp_m183_goals_frozen = 1
				var:zg361_pp_m183_manager_signed = 1
				OR = {
					var:zg361_pp_m183_subject_signed = 1
					var:zg361_pp_m183_independent_review_pass = 1
				}
			}
			else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				var:zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_available >= 1
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				var:zg361_pp_w_pip_capacity_available >= 1
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			always = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
			zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
			OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
			CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
			CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
			STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
			ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
			REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_w_revision
			TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_w_timeline_serial
			FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_w_feedback_revision
			LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_w_last_operation
			LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_w_last_choice
			RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m184_receipt_owner
			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_pp_m184_receipt_subject
			RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m184_receipt_cycle
			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m184_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_pp_m184_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_pp_m184_receipt_route
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			CHOICE = scope:zg361_pp_route
			OPERATION_ID = 184
			}
		}
		else = {
			# Route C is a policy-debt receipt, not a disguised business mutation.  It
			# deliberately does not call record_operation and therefore cannot change
			# the case revision, last operation, resource ledger, or typed payload.
			set_variable = { name = zg361_case_kernel_applied value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m184_receipt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m184_receipt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m184_receipt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m184_receipt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m184_receipt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m184_receipt_route value = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
					STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
					ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
					REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_w_revision
					AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_available
					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_reserved
					RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m184_operation_capacity_amount
					RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m184_operation_capacity_status
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m184_operation_capacity_owner
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m184_operation_capacity_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m184_operation_capacity_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
						CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
						REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_w_revision
						RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_reserved
						SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_settled
						RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m184_operation_capacity_amount
						RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m184_operation_capacity_status
						TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
					zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
						CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
						REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_w_revision
						AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_w_pip_capacity_available
						RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_w_pip_capacity_reserved
						RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m184_pip_capacity_amount
						RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m184_pip_capacity_status
						RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m184_pip_capacity_owner
						RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m184_pip_capacity_cycle
						RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m184_pip_capacity_case
						TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
						AMOUNT = 1
					}
					if = {
						# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
						# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
						limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
							OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
							SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
							CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
							CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
							STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
							ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
							REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_w_revision
							RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_w_pip_capacity_reserved
							SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_w_pip_capacity_settled
							RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m184_pip_capacity_amount
							RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m184_pip_capacity_status
							TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
							TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
							TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
							TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
							TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }

				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
						var:zg361_pp_m184_operation_capacity_status = 1
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_pp_m184_operation_capacity_status = 2
					}
					else = { always = yes }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
						var:zg361_pp_m184_pip_capacity_status = 1
					}
					trigger_else = { always = yes }
					always = yes
				}
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m184_receipt_active value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m184_route value = scope:zg361_pp_route }

					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m184_pip_caseload value = 1 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_evidence_led add = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {

					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_political add = 1 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m184_deferred value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m184_policy_debt_due_days value = 90 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_policy_debt add = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m184_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_w_owner }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m184_object_subject value = this }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m184_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_w_cycle_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m184_object_case value = var:zg361_case_w_case_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m184_object_state value = 2 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m184_active_case value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m184_capacity_reserved value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m184_support_status value = 2 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m184_release_once value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m184_overload_liability value = 0 }
					if = { limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m184_capacity_reserved value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m184_support_status value = 1 } }
					else_if = { limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m184_overload_liability value = 1 } }

				}

				zg361_pp_m184_consume_effect = yes
				zg361_pp_m184_schedule_audit_1_effect = yes

	}

# 185 PIP 中期检查: typed A/B/C write -> PIP 时间线消费进度、资源交付和目标有效性.
zg361_pp_m185_core_effect = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_cost_owner value = var:zg361_case_w_owner }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 }
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m185_receipt_active = 0
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				var:zg361_pp_m184_active_case = 1
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				var:zg361_pp_m184_active_case = 1
			}
			else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				var:zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_available >= 1
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			always = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
			zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
			OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
			CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
			CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
			STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
			ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
			REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_w_revision
			TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_w_timeline_serial
			FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_w_feedback_revision
			LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_w_last_operation
			LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_w_last_choice
			RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m185_receipt_owner
			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_pp_m185_receipt_subject
			RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m185_receipt_cycle
			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m185_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_pp_m185_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_pp_m185_receipt_route
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			CHOICE = scope:zg361_pp_route
			OPERATION_ID = 185
			}
		}
		else = {
			# Route C is a policy-debt receipt, not a disguised business mutation.  It
			# deliberately does not call record_operation and therefore cannot change
			# the case revision, last operation, resource ledger, or typed payload.
			set_variable = { name = zg361_case_kernel_applied value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_receipt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_receipt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_receipt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_receipt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_receipt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_receipt_route value = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
					STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
					ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
					REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_w_revision
					AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_available
					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_reserved
					RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m185_operation_capacity_amount
					RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m185_operation_capacity_status
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m185_operation_capacity_owner
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m185_operation_capacity_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m185_operation_capacity_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
						CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
						REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_w_revision
						RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_reserved
						SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_settled
						RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m185_operation_capacity_amount
						RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m185_operation_capacity_status
						TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }

				}
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }

				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
						var:zg361_pp_m185_operation_capacity_status = 1
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_pp_m185_operation_capacity_status = 2
					}
					else = { always = yes }
					always = yes
					always = yes
				}
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_receipt_active value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_route value = scope:zg361_pp_route }
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_pip_midpoint value = 1 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_evidence_led add = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_pip_midpoint value = 2 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_political add = 1 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_deferred value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_policy_debt_due_days value = 90 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_policy_debt add = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_w_owner }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_object_subject value = this }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_w_cycle_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_object_case value = var:zg361_case_w_case_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_object_state value = 2 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_midpoint_due_days value = 180 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_midpoint_status value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_midpoint_pending value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_midpoint_completed value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_corrections_remaining value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_skipped_midpoint value = 0 }
					if = { limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_corrections_remaining value = 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_skipped_midpoint value = 1 } }

				}

				zg361_pp_m185_consume_effect = yes
				zg361_pp_m185_schedule_audit_1_effect = yes
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

zg361_pp_m185_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_pp_m185_receipt_owner
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = var:zg361_pp_m185_receipt_subject
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_pp_m185_receipt_cycle
				EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_pp_m185_receipt_case
				EXPECTED_STATE = var:zg361_pp_m185_receipt_state
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m185_receipt_active = 1
			var:zg361_pp_m185_consumed = 0
			has_variable = zg361_pp_m185_route
			always = yes
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m185_route = 3 } }
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m185_pip_midpoint
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_consumed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_consumer_revision value = var:zg361_case_w_revision }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m185_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_consumer_value value = var:zg361_pp_m185_pip_midpoint } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_completed add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_partition value = var:zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_w_resource_partition = var:zg361_pp_w_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_conserved value = 1 } }

		zg361_pp_w_try_advance_02_effect = yes
	}
}

zg361_pp_m185_schedule_audit_1_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m185_audit_1_state = 0 var:zg361_pp_m185_receipt_active = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_audit_1_owner value = var:zg361_case_w_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_audit_1_subject value = this }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_audit_1_cycle value = var:zg361_case_w_cycle_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_audit_1_case value = var:zg361_case_w_case_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_audit_1_expected_state value = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_audit_1_state value = 1 }
		if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m185_route = 3 }
		trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.2185 days = 90 }
	}
	else = { trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.2185 days = 180 } }
	}
}

zg361_pp_m186_manager_apply_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	if = {
		limit = {
			root = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
			zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
			liege = root
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
		}
		zg361_pp_m186_core_effect = {
			ROUTE = $ROUTE$
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
		}
	}
}

# 186 PIP 目标膨胀锁: typed A/B/C write -> 变更账比较基线、当前工作量和补偿路线.
zg361_pp_m186_core_effect = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_cost_owner value = var:zg361_case_w_owner }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 }
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner

				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m186_receipt_active = 0
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				var:zg361_pp_m185_audit_1_consumed = 1
				OR = {
					var:zg361_pp_m185_midpoint_status = 1
					var:zg361_pp_m185_midpoint_status = 2
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				var:zg361_pp_m185_audit_1_consumed = 1
				OR = {
					var:zg361_pp_m185_midpoint_status = 1
					var:zg361_pp_m185_midpoint_status = 2

			}
			else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				var:zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_available >= 1
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }

			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m186_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_pp_m186_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_pp_m186_receipt_route
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$

					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject

					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial

					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_reserved
					RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m186_operation_capacity_amount

					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {

						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active

						RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_reserved

						TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$

					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m186_policy_debt_due_days value = 90 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_policy_debt add = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m186_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_w_owner }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m186_object_subject value = this }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m186_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_w_cycle_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m186_object_case value = var:zg361_case_w_case_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m186_object_state value = 3 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m186_baseline_workload value = 100 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m186_current_workload value = 100 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m186_replacement_workload value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m186_deadline_extension_days value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m186_goal_creep_violation value = 0 }
					if = { limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m186_current_workload value = 130 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m186_goal_creep_violation value = 1 } }

				}

				zg361_pp_m186_consume_effect = yes
				zg361_pp_m186_schedule_audit_1_effect = yes
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

zg361_pp_m186_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_pp_m186_receipt_owner
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = var:zg361_pp_m186_receipt_subject
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_pp_m186_receipt_cycle
				EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_pp_m186_receipt_case
				EXPECTED_STATE = var:zg361_pp_m186_receipt_state
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m186_receipt_active = 1
			var:zg361_pp_m186_consumed = 0
			has_variable = zg361_pp_m186_route
			always = yes
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m186_route = 3 } }
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m186_goal_creep_lock
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m186_consumed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m186_consumer_revision value = var:zg361_case_w_revision }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m186_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m186_consumer_value value = var:zg361_pp_m186_goal_creep_lock } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_completed add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_partition value = var:zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_w_resource_partition = var:zg361_pp_w_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_conserved value = 1 } }

		zg361_pp_w_try_advance_03_effect = yes
	}
}

	}
}

# 187 PIP 毕业标准: typed A/B/C write -> 毕业关闭升级并释放容量，但绝不直接写 3.75.
zg361_pp_m187_core_effect = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_cost_owner value = var:zg361_case_w_owner }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 }
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m187_receipt_active = 0
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				var:zg361_pp_m185_audit_1_consumed = 1
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m186_baseline_workload
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				var:zg361_pp_m185_audit_1_consumed = 1
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m186_baseline_workload
			}
			else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				var:zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_available >= 1
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			always = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
			zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
			OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
			CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
			CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
			STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
			ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
			REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_w_revision
			TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_w_timeline_serial
			FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_w_feedback_revision
			LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_w_last_operation
			LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_w_last_choice
			RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m187_receipt_owner
			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_pp_m187_receipt_subject
			RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m187_receipt_cycle
			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m187_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_pp_m187_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_pp_m187_receipt_route
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			CHOICE = scope:zg361_pp_route
			OPERATION_ID = 187
			}
		}
		else = {
			# Route C is a policy-debt receipt, not a disguised business mutation.  It
			# deliberately does not call record_operation and therefore cannot change
			# the case revision, last operation, resource ledger, or typed payload.
			set_variable = { name = zg361_case_kernel_applied value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m187_receipt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m187_receipt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m187_receipt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m187_receipt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m187_receipt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m187_receipt_route value = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
					STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
					ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
					REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_w_revision
					AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_available
					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_reserved
					RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m187_operation_capacity_amount
					RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m187_operation_capacity_status
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m187_operation_capacity_owner
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m187_operation_capacity_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m187_operation_capacity_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
						CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
						REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_w_revision
						RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_reserved
						SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_settled
						RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m187_operation_capacity_amount
						RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m187_operation_capacity_status
						TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }

				}
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }

				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
						var:zg361_pp_m187_operation_capacity_status = 1
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_pp_m187_operation_capacity_status = 2
					}
					else = { always = yes }
					always = yes
					always = yes
				}
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m187_receipt_active value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m187_route value = scope:zg361_pp_route }
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m187_graduation_gate value = 1 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_evidence_led add = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m187_graduation_gate value = 2 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_political add = 1 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m187_deferred value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m187_policy_debt_due_days value = 90 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_policy_debt add = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m187_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_w_owner }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m187_object_subject value = this }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m187_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_w_cycle_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m187_object_case value = var:zg361_case_w_case_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m187_object_state value = 3 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m187_milestone_evidence_submitted value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m187_stability_days_required value = 90 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m187_independent_review_required value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m187_evaluation_pending value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m187_graduation_status value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m187_writes_top_grade value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m187_opaque_extension value = 0 }
					if = { limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m187_opaque_extension value = 1 } }

				}

				zg361_pp_m187_consume_effect = yes
				zg361_pp_m187_schedule_audit_1_effect = yes
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}
