# 188 毕业后的复发观察期: typed A/B/C write -> 观察标记到期一次；新问题必须另开案.
zg361_pp_m188_core_effect = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_cost_owner value = var:zg361_case_w_owner }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 }
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m188_receipt_active = 0
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				var:zg361_pp_m187_graduation_status = 1
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				var:zg361_pp_m187_graduation_status = 1
				var:zg361_pp_m187_graduation_status = 1
			}
			else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				var:zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_available >= 1
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			always = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
			zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
			OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
			CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
			CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
			STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
			ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
			REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_w_revision
			TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_w_timeline_serial
			FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_w_feedback_revision
			LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_w_last_operation
			LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_w_last_choice
			RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m188_receipt_owner
			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_pp_m188_receipt_subject
			RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m188_receipt_cycle
			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m188_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_pp_m188_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_pp_m188_receipt_route
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			CHOICE = scope:zg361_pp_route
			OPERATION_ID = 188
			}
		}
		else = {
			# Route C is a policy-debt receipt, not a disguised business mutation.  It
			# deliberately does not call record_operation and therefore cannot change
			# the case revision, last operation, resource ledger, or typed payload.
			set_variable = { name = zg361_case_kernel_applied value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_receipt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_receipt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_receipt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_receipt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_receipt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_receipt_route value = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
					STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
					ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
					REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_w_revision
					AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_available
					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_reserved
					RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m188_operation_capacity_amount
					RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m188_operation_capacity_status
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m188_operation_capacity_owner
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m188_operation_capacity_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m188_operation_capacity_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
						CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
						REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_w_revision
						RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_reserved
						SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_settled
						RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m188_operation_capacity_amount
						RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m188_operation_capacity_status
						TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }

				}
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }

				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
						var:zg361_pp_m188_operation_capacity_status = 1
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_pp_m188_operation_capacity_status = 2
					}
					else = { always = yes }
					always = yes
					always = yes
				}
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_receipt_active value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_route value = scope:zg361_pp_route }
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_relapse_window value = 1 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_evidence_led add = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_relapse_window value = 2 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_political add = 1 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_deferred value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_policy_debt_due_days value = 90 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_policy_debt add = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_w_owner }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_object_subject value = this }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_w_cycle_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_object_case value = var:zg361_case_w_case_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_object_state value = 4 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_observation_days value = 365 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_observation_start_cycle value = root.var:zg361_review_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_observation_due_cycle value = { value = root.var:zg361_review_serial add = 1 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_same_category_only value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_category_snapshot value = var:zg361_pp_m181_primary_category }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_observation_pending value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_observation_closed value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_same_category_relapse value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_relapse_status value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_overbreadth_risk value = 0 }
					if = { limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_same_category_only value = 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_overbreadth_risk value = 1 } }

				}

				zg361_pp_m188_consume_effect = yes
				zg361_pp_m188_schedule_audit_1_effect = yes
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

zg361_pp_m188_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_pp_m188_receipt_owner
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = var:zg361_pp_m188_receipt_subject
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_pp_m188_receipt_cycle
				EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_pp_m188_receipt_case
				EXPECTED_STATE = var:zg361_pp_m188_receipt_state
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m188_receipt_active = 1
			var:zg361_pp_m188_consumed = 0
			has_variable = zg361_pp_m188_route
			always = yes
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m188_route = 3 } }
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m188_relapse_window
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_consumed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_consumer_revision value = var:zg361_case_w_revision }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m188_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_consumer_value value = var:zg361_pp_m188_relapse_window } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_completed add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_partition value = var:zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_w_resource_partition = var:zg361_pp_w_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_conserved value = 1 } }

		zg361_pp_w_try_advance_04_effect = yes
	}
}

zg361_pp_m188_schedule_audit_1_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m188_audit_1_state = 0 var:zg361_pp_m188_receipt_active = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_audit_1_owner value = var:zg361_case_w_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_audit_1_subject value = this }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_audit_1_cycle value = var:zg361_case_w_cycle_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_audit_1_case value = var:zg361_case_w_case_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_audit_1_expected_state value = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_audit_1_state value = 1 }
		if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m188_route = 3 }
		trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.2188 days = 90 }
	}
	else = { trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.2188 days = 365 } }
	}
}

zg361_pp_m189_manager_apply_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	if = {

			liege = root
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial

				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
		}
		zg361_pp_m189_core_effect = {
			ROUTE = $ROUTE$
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
		}
	}
}

	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied

	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 }
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner

				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }

					if = {
						# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
						# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
						limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
							OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
							SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
							CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
							CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
							STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
							ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
							REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_w_revision
							RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_w_exit_cost_reserved
							SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_w_exit_cost_settled
							RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m189_exit_cost_amount
							RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m189_exit_cost_status
							TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
							TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
							TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
							TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
							TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
						var:zg361_pp_m189_operation_capacity_status = 1
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_pp_m189_operation_capacity_status = 2
					}
					else = { always = yes }
					always = yes
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_pp_m189_exit_cost_status = 2
					}
					trigger_else = { always = yes }
				}
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m189_receipt_active value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m189_route value = scope:zg361_pp_route }
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m189_terminal_fork value = 1 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_evidence_led add = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m189_terminal_fork value = 2 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_political add = 1 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m189_deferred value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m189_policy_debt_due_days value = 90 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_policy_debt add = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m189_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_w_owner }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m189_object_subject value = this }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m189_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_w_cycle_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m189_object_case value = var:zg361_case_w_case_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m189_object_state value = 4 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m189_second_pip value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m189_transfer value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m189_exit value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m189_terminal_code value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m189_real_vacancy_required value = 1 }
					if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 var:zg361_pp_m181_primary_category = 3 var:zg361_pp_w_real_vacancy = 1 }
						set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m189_transfer value = 1 }
						set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m189_terminal_code value = 2 }
						set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m189_receiving_manager value = var:zg361_pp_w_receiving_manager }
						set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m189_vacancy_id value = var:zg361_pp_w_transfer_vacancy_id }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
						set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m189_second_pip value = 1 }
						set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m189_terminal_code value = 1 }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m189_exit value = 1 }
						set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m189_terminal_code value = 3 }
						set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m189_forced_exit value = 1 }
						set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m189_replacement_cost value = 10 }
					}
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m189_terminal_sum value = var:zg361_pp_m189_second_pip }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m189_terminal_sum add = var:zg361_pp_m189_transfer }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m189_terminal_sum add = var:zg361_pp_m189_exit }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m189_exclusive_terminal value = 0 }
					if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_m189_terminal_sum = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m189_exclusive_terminal value = 1 } }
					if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_case_w_owner = {
							remove_treasury = 5
							remove_gold = 5
						}
						add_gold = 10
						set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m189_treasury_paid value = 5 }
						set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m189_personal_paid value = 5 }
						set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m189_subject_received value = 10 }
						set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m189_dual_payment_conserved value = 1 }
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						var:zg361_pp_w_capacity_released = 0
						var:zg361_pp_m184_pip_capacity_status = 1
					}
					zg361_case_kernel_refund_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
						CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
						REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_w_revision
						AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_w_pip_capacity_available
						RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_w_pip_capacity_reserved
						SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_w_pip_capacity_settled
						RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m184_pip_capacity_amount
						RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m184_pip_capacity_status
						TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_w_owner
						TICKET_SUBJECT = this
						TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
						TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_w_case_serial
						TICKET_STATE = 4
					}
					if = {
						limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
						set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_capacity_released value = 1 }
						set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_capacity_release_reason value = 2 }
						set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m184_capacity_reserved value = 0 }
						set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m184_active_case value = 0 }
						set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m184_release_once value = 0 }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_pp_w_capacity_released = 0 NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m184_pip_capacity_status = 1 } }
					# Political overbooking never reserved capacity, so terminal closure records
					# a no-release receipt rather than manufacturing one.
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_capacity_released value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_capacity_release_reason value = 2 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m184_active_case value = 0 }
				}
				zg361_pp_m189_consume_effect = yes
				zg361_pp_m189_schedule_audit_1_effect = yes
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

zg361_pp_m189_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_pp_m189_receipt_owner
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = var:zg361_pp_m189_receipt_subject
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_pp_m189_receipt_cycle
				EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_pp_m189_receipt_case
				EXPECTED_STATE = var:zg361_pp_m189_receipt_state
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m189_receipt_active = 1
			var:zg361_pp_m189_consumed = 0
			has_variable = zg361_pp_m189_route
			always = yes
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m189_route = 3 } }
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m189_terminal_fork
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m189_consumed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m189_consumer_revision value = var:zg361_case_w_revision }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m189_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m189_consumer_value value = var:zg361_pp_m189_terminal_fork } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_completed add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_partition value = var:zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_w_resource_partition = var:zg361_pp_w_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_conserved value = 1 } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_exit_cost_partition value = var:zg361_pp_w_exit_cost_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_exit_cost_partition add = var:zg361_pp_w_exit_cost_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_exit_cost_partition add = var:zg361_pp_w_exit_cost_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_exit_cost_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_w_exit_cost_partition = var:zg361_pp_w_exit_cost_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_exit_cost_conserved value = 1 } }
		zg361_pp_w_try_advance_04_effect = yes
	}
}

	}
	else = { trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.2189 days = 30 } }
	}
}

			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
		}
	}
}

# The assessed official may respond only to their own packet.  This grants no
# cohort, nomination, panel, PIP-initiation or assessment authority.
zg361_pp_m190_subject_response_effect = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_subject_route value = $ROUTE$ }
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_ai = no
			OR = { scope:zg361_pp_subject_route = 1 scope:zg361_pp_subject_route = 2 }
			zg361_case_kernel_subject_self_guard_trigger = {
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
			}
			var:zg361_case_w_state = 5
			NOT = { has_variable = zg361_pp_m190_subject_response }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_subject_response value = scope:zg361_pp_subject_route }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_subject_statement_author value = this }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_subject_statement_receiver value = var:zg361_pp_m190_acl_receiver }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_subject_statement_version value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_subject_statement_private_ids value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_subject_statement_code value = scope:zg361_pp_subject_route }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_subject_statement_snapshot value = scope:zg361_pp_subject_route }
		save_temporary_scope_as = zg361_pp_m190_statement_subject
		var:zg361_pp_m190_acl_receiver = { set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_received_transfer_subject_statement value = scope:zg361_pp_m190_statement_subject.var:zg361_pp_m190_subject_statement_snapshot } }
		if = { limit = { scope:zg361_pp_subject_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_subject_disclosure_refused value = 1 } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_case_w_feedback_revision add = 1 }
	}
}

# 190 PIP 随转岗披露的最小范围: typed A/B/C write -> 转岗包按 ACL 投影最小字段.
zg361_pp_m190_core_effect = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_cost_owner value = var:zg361_case_w_owner }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 }
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m190_receipt_active = 0
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				var:zg361_pp_m189_terminal_code = 2
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m189_receiving_manager
				var:zg361_pp_m189_receiving_manager = var:zg361_pp_w_receiving_manager
				has_variable = zg361_pp_w_transfer_vacancy_id
				var:zg361_pp_w_transfer_vacancy_active = 1
				var:zg361_pp_w_transfer_vacancy_receiver = var:zg361_pp_m189_receiving_manager
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m183_goal_bundle_id
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m184_support_status
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m187_graduation_status
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m183_subject_statement_code
				var:zg361_pp_m189_receiving_manager = {
					zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
					NOT = { this = root }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				var:zg361_pp_m189_terminal_code = 2
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m189_receiving_manager
				var:zg361_pp_m189_receiving_manager = var:zg361_pp_w_receiving_manager
				has_variable = zg361_pp_w_transfer_vacancy_id
				var:zg361_pp_w_transfer_vacancy_active = 1
				var:zg361_pp_w_transfer_vacancy_receiver = var:zg361_pp_m189_receiving_manager
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m183_goal_bundle_id
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m184_support_status
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m187_graduation_status
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m183_subject_statement_code
				var:zg361_pp_m189_receiving_manager = {
					zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
					NOT = { this = root }
				}
			}
			else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				var:zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_available >= 1
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			always = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
			zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
			OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
			CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
			CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
			STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
			ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
			REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_w_revision
			TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_w_timeline_serial
			FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_w_feedback_revision
			LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_w_last_operation
			LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_w_last_choice
			RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m190_receipt_owner
			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_pp_m190_receipt_subject
			RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m190_receipt_cycle
			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m190_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_pp_m190_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_pp_m190_receipt_route
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			CHOICE = scope:zg361_pp_route
			OPERATION_ID = 190
			}
		}
		else = {
			# Route C is a policy-debt receipt, not a disguised business mutation.  It
			# deliberately does not call record_operation and therefore cannot change
			# the case revision, last operation, resource ledger, or typed payload.
			set_variable = { name = zg361_case_kernel_applied value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_receipt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_receipt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_receipt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_receipt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_receipt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_receipt_route value = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
					STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
					ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
					REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_w_revision
					AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_available
					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_reserved
					RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m190_operation_capacity_amount
					RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m190_operation_capacity_status
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m190_operation_capacity_owner
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m190_operation_capacity_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m190_operation_capacity_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
						CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
						REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_w_revision
						RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_reserved
						SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_settled
						RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m190_operation_capacity_amount
						RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m190_operation_capacity_status
						TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }

				}
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }

				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
						var:zg361_pp_m190_operation_capacity_status = 1
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_pp_m190_operation_capacity_status = 2
					}
					else = { always = yes }
					always = yes
					always = yes
				}
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_receipt_active value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_route value = scope:zg361_pp_route }
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_transfer_disclosure value = 1 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_evidence_led add = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_transfer_disclosure value = 2 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_political add = 1 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_deferred value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_policy_debt_due_days value = 90 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_policy_debt add = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_w_owner }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_object_subject value = this }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_w_cycle_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_object_case value = var:zg361_case_w_case_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_object_state value = 5 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_disclosure_bundle_id value = { value = var:zg361_case_w_case_serial multiply = 1000 add = 190 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_receiving_manager value = var:zg361_pp_m189_receiving_manager }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_acl_subject value = this }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_acl_receiver value = var:zg361_pp_m189_receiving_manager }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_vacancy_id_snapshot value = var:zg361_pp_w_transfer_vacancy_id }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_goal_snapshot value = var:zg361_pp_m183_goal_bundle_id }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_support_snapshot value = var:zg361_pp_m184_support_status }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_completion_snapshot value = var:zg361_pp_m187_graduation_status }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_subject_statement_snapshot value = var:zg361_pp_m183_subject_statement_code }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_disclosed_fields value = 4 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_private_ids_excluded value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_old_rating_snapshot value = var:zg361_pp_w_non_aggravation_grade }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_old_rating_unchanged value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_acl_pass value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_stigma_risk value = 0 }
					if = { limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_stigma_risk value = 1 } }
					save_temporary_scope_as = zg361_pp_m190_disclosure_subject
					var:zg361_pp_m190_acl_receiver = {
						set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_received_transfer_disclosure_bundle value = scope:zg361_pp_m190_disclosure_subject.var:zg361_pp_m190_disclosure_bundle_id }
						set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_received_transfer_disclosure_subject value = scope:zg361_pp_m190_disclosure_subject }
						set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_received_transfer_disclosure_cycle value = scope:zg361_pp_m190_disclosure_subject.var:zg361_case_w_cycle_serial }
						set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_received_transfer_disclosure_case value = scope:zg361_pp_m190_disclosure_subject.var:zg361_case_w_case_serial }
						set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_received_transfer_disclosure_vacancy value = scope:zg361_pp_m190_disclosure_subject.var:zg361_pp_m190_vacancy_id_snapshot }
						set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_received_transfer_goal value = scope:zg361_pp_m190_disclosure_subject.var:zg361_pp_m190_goal_snapshot }
						set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_received_transfer_support value = scope:zg361_pp_m190_disclosure_subject.var:zg361_pp_m190_support_snapshot }
						set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_received_transfer_completion value = scope:zg361_pp_m190_disclosure_subject.var:zg361_pp_m190_completion_snapshot }
						set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_received_transfer_subject_statement value = scope:zg361_pp_m190_disclosure_subject.var:zg361_pp_m190_subject_statement_snapshot }
					}

				}

				zg361_pp_m190_consume_effect = yes
				zg361_pp_m190_schedule_audit_1_effect = yes
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

zg361_pp_m190_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_pp_m190_receipt_owner
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = var:zg361_pp_m190_receipt_subject
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_pp_m190_receipt_cycle
				EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_pp_m190_receipt_case
				EXPECTED_STATE = var:zg361_pp_m190_receipt_state
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m190_receipt_active = 1
			var:zg361_pp_m190_consumed = 0
			has_variable = zg361_pp_m190_route
			always = yes
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m190_route = 3 } }
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m190_transfer_disclosure
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_consumed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_consumer_revision value = var:zg361_case_w_revision }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m190_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_consumer_value value = var:zg361_pp_m190_transfer_disclosure } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_completed add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_partition value = var:zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_w_resource_partition = var:zg361_pp_w_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_conserved value = 1 } }

		zg361_pp_w_try_advance_05_effect = yes
	}
}

zg361_pp_m190_schedule_audit_1_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m190_audit_1_state = 0 var:zg361_pp_m190_receipt_active = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_audit_1_owner value = var:zg361_case_w_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_audit_1_subject value = this }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_audit_1_cycle value = var:zg361_case_w_cycle_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_audit_1_case value = var:zg361_case_w_case_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_audit_1_expected_state value = 5 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_audit_1_state value = 1 }
		if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m190_route = 3 }
		trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.2190 days = 90 }
	}
	else = { trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.2190 days = 30 } }
	}
}

zg361_pp_m191_manager_apply_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	if = {
		limit = {
			root = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
			zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
			liege = root
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
		}
		zg361_pp_m191_core_effect = {
			ROUTE = $ROUTE$
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
		}
	}
}

# 191 PIP 退出后的团队成本单: typed A/B/C write -> 团队成本表和经理记分卡消费同一净额.
zg361_pp_m191_core_effect = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
	remove_variable = zg361_pp_runtime_applied
	set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_cost_owner value = var:zg361_case_w_owner }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 }
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m191_receipt_active = 0
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				var:zg361_pp_m189_terminal_code = 3
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				var:zg361_pp_m189_terminal_code = 3
			}
			else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				var:zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_available >= 1
				var:zg361_pp_w_exit_cost_available >= 1
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				var:zg361_pp_cost_owner = {
					government_has_flag = government_has_treasury
					treasury >= 5
					gold >= 5
				}
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
			zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
			OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
			CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
			CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
			STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
			ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
			REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_w_revision
			TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_w_timeline_serial
			FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_w_feedback_revision
			LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_w_last_operation
			LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_w_last_choice
			RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m191_receipt_owner
			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_pp_m191_receipt_subject
			RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m191_receipt_cycle
			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m191_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_pp_m191_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_pp_m191_receipt_route
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			CHOICE = scope:zg361_pp_route
			OPERATION_ID = 191
			}
		}
		else = {
			# Route C is a policy-debt receipt, not a disguised business mutation.  It
			# deliberately does not call record_operation and therefore cannot change
			# the case revision, last operation, resource ledger, or typed payload.
			set_variable = { name = zg361_case_kernel_applied value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_receipt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_receipt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_receipt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_receipt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_receipt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_receipt_route value = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
					STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
					ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
					REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_w_revision
					AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_available
					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_reserved
					RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m191_operation_capacity_amount
					RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m191_operation_capacity_status
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m191_operation_capacity_owner
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m191_operation_capacity_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m191_operation_capacity_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject

						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
						REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_w_revision
						RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_reserved
						SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_settled
						RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m191_operation_capacity_amount
						RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m191_operation_capacity_status
						TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					}
				}
				zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
					STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
					ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
					REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_w_revision
					AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_w_exit_cost_available
					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_w_exit_cost_reserved
					RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m191_exit_cost_amount
					RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m191_exit_cost_status
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m191_exit_cost_owner
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m191_exit_cost_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m191_exit_cost_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
						CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
						REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_w_revision
						RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_w_exit_cost_reserved
						SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_w_exit_cost_settled
						RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m191_exit_cost_amount
						RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m191_exit_cost_status
						TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }

				}
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }

				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
						var:zg361_pp_m191_operation_capacity_status = 1
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_pp_m191_operation_capacity_status = 2
					}
					else = { always = yes }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
						var:zg361_pp_m191_exit_cost_status = 1
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_pp_m191_exit_cost_status = 2
					}

					always = yes
					always = yes
				}
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_receipt_active value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_route value = scope:zg361_pp_route }

					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_exit_cost_statement value = 1 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_evidence_led add = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_exit_cost_statement value = 2 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_political add = 1 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_deferred value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_policy_debt_due_days value = 90 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_policy_debt add = 1 }

					limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_w_owner }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_object_subject value = this }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_w_cycle_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_object_case value = var:zg361_case_w_case_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_object_state value = 5 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_terminal_code_consumed value = var:zg361_pp_m189_terminal_code }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_vacancy_cost value = 3 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_handover_cost value = 2 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_overtime_cost value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_replacement_cost value = 5 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_net_cost value = 10 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_cost_conserved value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_hidden_cost_debt value = 0 }
					if = { limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_net_cost value = 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_cost_conserved value = 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_hidden_cost_debt value = 10 } }
					if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
						var:zg361_case_w_owner = {
							remove_treasury = 5
							remove_gold = 5
						}
						add_gold = 10
						set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_treasury_paid value = 5 }
						set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_personal_paid value = 5 }
						set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_subject_received value = 10 }
						set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_dual_payment_conserved value = 1 }
					}
				}

				zg361_pp_m191_consume_effect = yes
				zg361_pp_m191_schedule_audit_1_effect = yes
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

zg361_pp_m191_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_pp_m191_receipt_owner
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = var:zg361_pp_m191_receipt_subject
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_pp_m191_receipt_cycle
				EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_pp_m191_receipt_case
				EXPECTED_STATE = var:zg361_pp_m191_receipt_state
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m191_receipt_active = 1
			var:zg361_pp_m191_consumed = 0
			has_variable = zg361_pp_m191_route
			always = yes
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m191_route = 3 } }
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m191_exit_cost_statement
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_consumed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_consumer_revision value = var:zg361_case_w_revision }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m191_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_consumer_value value = var:zg361_pp_m191_exit_cost_statement } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_completed add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_partition value = var:zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_w_resource_partition = var:zg361_pp_w_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_conserved value = 1 } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_exit_cost_partition value = var:zg361_pp_w_exit_cost_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_exit_cost_partition add = var:zg361_pp_w_exit_cost_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_exit_cost_partition add = var:zg361_pp_w_exit_cost_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_exit_cost_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_w_exit_cost_partition = var:zg361_pp_w_exit_cost_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_exit_cost_conserved value = 1 } }
		zg361_pp_w_try_advance_05_effect = yes
	}
}

zg361_pp_m191_schedule_audit_1_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m191_audit_1_state = 0 var:zg361_pp_m191_receipt_active = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_audit_1_owner value = var:zg361_case_w_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_audit_1_subject value = this }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_audit_1_cycle value = var:zg361_case_w_cycle_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_audit_1_case value = var:zg361_case_w_case_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_audit_1_expected_state value = 5 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_audit_1_state value = 1 }
		if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m191_route = 3 }
		trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.2191 days = 90 }
	}
	else = { trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.2191 days = 30 } }
	}
}
